qe: Which caste, listed as Ahirs or Goalas, was the most numerous in the Patna district?
qh: पटना जिले में सबसे अधिक संख्या वाली जाति कौन-सी थी, जिसे अहीर या गोअला भी कहा जाता था?
e: Patna jile me jatiyon ki ganana karne par sabse aage Goalas yaani Ahir jati dikhti hai; inki sankhya do lakh se bhi zyada thi. Goalas tatha Ahirs ek hi samuday ke do naam hain, jo mukhya roop se kheti tatha pashupalan karte the. Inhe mehnati tatha kifayati maana jaata tha, kyunki ye apna anaj tatha uski bhusi bech kar paisa banate the tatha khud mota anaj khate the; unki auratein doodh, makkhan tatha ghee bechne shahar tatha bazaar jaati thin, jabki unke mard apne pashuon ke liye ghaas kaatte the. Is samuday me kuch bade zamindar bhi the, kuch khetihar tatha kuch mazdoor. Pashupalak yaani pastoral jeevan ke kaaran inka gaon tatha shahar ke bazaar dono se gahra rishta tha. Exam point: Patna jile ki sabse badi jati Goalas yaani Ahirs thi, jinki sankhya do lakh se zyada thi; ye kheti tatha pashupalan karte the, auratein doodh-makkhan-ghee bechti thin, mard ghaas kaatte the tatha ye khud mota anaj khate the.

qe: Which caste was next to the Goalas in number in the Patna district and was almost entirely employed in cultivation?
qh: पटना जिले में संख्या में गोअलाओं के बाद कौन-सी जाति थी, जो लगभग पूरी तरह खेती में लगी हुई थी?
e: Patna jile me Goalas ke baad sankhya me sabse badi jati Kurmi thi tatha yah lagbhag poori tarah kheti ke kaam me lagi hui thi. Kurmi log aam taur par mukhya faslon par dhyan dete the tatha pashupalan yaani cattle-breeding nahi karte the, isliye unka poora dhyan hal-jot tatha fasl par rahta tha. Inme se kuch log khidmatgar yaani sevak ka kaam lete the, kuch zamindar tatha thekadar ban gaye the, tatha shaharon me kai Kurmi log paisa udhaar dene ka kaam karte the. Isi tarah ye aksar chhoti-chhoti mukadamebazi tatha fasl yaani crops tatha zameen ke adhikar ke jhagde karne me bhi shamil hote the, jisse unke naam ki ek alag pehchaan ban gayi. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki kheti ke saath-saath paisa-udhaar tatha zamindari ke theke lene ka kaam bhi kisan jatiyon me phail raha tha. Exam point: Patna jile me sankhya me doosri sabse badi jati Kurmi thi, jo lagbhag poori tarah kheti me lagi thi; ye mukhya faslon par dhyan dete the tatha pashu nahi paalte the; kuch Kurmi shaharon me paisa udhaar dene ka kaam bhi karte the tatha mukadamebazi me shamil hote the.

qe: Babhans, the third group in number, formed the greater portion of which class in the Patna district?
qh: संख्या में तीसरा बड़ा समूह बाबहन (भूमिहार) पटना जिले में किस वर्ग का बड़ा हिस्सा था?
oe: The zamindars, agricultural thikadars and well-to-do cultivators
The merchants of the city markets
e: Patna jile me sankhya ke hisaab se teesra bada samuh Babhans yaani Bhumihar ka tha tatha ye jile ke zamindaron, kheti ke thekadaron tatha sampann kisanon ka bada hissa the. Babhan log khud ko Brahman vansh se aaye maante the, isliye Brahmanon ki tarah ve khud hal nahi chalate the; kheti ke liye mazdoor rakhte the. Inme kai log Brahmanon jaise naam bhi rakhte the, jaise Pande, Mishra tatha Tewari, jisse unka apne ko Brahman batane ka dava jhalakta tha. Isi kaaran vidvanon ne yah vichaar diya ki Babhan jati ka udgam Brahman tatha anya jatiyon ke mel se hua hoga. Aisa varnan Magadh kshetra ki samajik banawat ko samajhne me madad karta hai. Exam point: Babhans yaani Bhumihar Patna jile ke zamindaron, kheti ke thekadaron tatha sampann kisanon ka bada hissa the; ve khud ko Brahman vansh ka batate the tatha Brahmanon ki tarah hal nahi chalate the; kuch log Pande, Mishra tatha Tewari jaise Brahman naam bhi rakhte the.

qe: Which word is described in the Patna district account as the Pali form of the word Brahman, a form also found in Ashoka's edicts?
qh: पटना जिले के वर्णन में किस शब्द को 'ब्राह्मण' का पाली रूप बताया गया है, जो अशोक के अभिलेखों में भी मिलता है?
e: Babhans jati ke naam ke baare me ek mahatvapurn baat batayi jaati hai - Babhan shabd asal me Brahman ka Pali roop hai tatha yah shabd Ashoka ke abhilekhon me bhi milta hai. Isi aadhaar par ek anuman lagaya jaata hai ki jab Magadh kshetra ke Brahman phir se Hindu dharm ki or laute, tab jo log Bauddh dharm par tike rahe, unhe unke naam ke Pali roop yaani Babhan se pukara jaane laga. Isi jati ka doosra naam Bhumihar tatha Bhuinhar bataya jaata hai, jiska arth un zameenon se joda jaata hai jo purane Bauddh viharon tatha mathon se juri thin. Yah bhi dekha gaya ki yah samuh mukhya roop se purane Magadh kshetra me hi milta hai, jahan lambe samay tak Bauddh dharm ka prabhav raha. Exam point: Babhan shabd Brahman ka Pali roop hai tatha yah Ashoka ke abhilekhon me bhi milta hai; isi jati ka doosra naam Bhumihar ya Bhuinhar hai, jise purane Bauddh viharon ki zameenon se joda jaata hai; yah samuh mukhya roop se purane Magadh kshetra me hi milta hai.

qe: In a local tradition of the Patna district, the Babhans were descended from men collected by the Diwan of which king of Magadha?
qh: पटना जिले की एक स्थानीय परंपरा के अनुसार बाबहन मगध के किस राजा के दीवान द्वारा जुटाए गए लोगों से उत्पन्न माने जाते हैं?
e: Babhans jati ke udgam ke baare me Patna kshetra me ek lok-parampara pracharit thi. Us parampara ke mutabik Magadha ke raja Jarasandha ne ek bade bhoj ka aayojan kiya tha tatha apne Diwan ko aadesh diya ki us bhoj me ek lakh chalis hazaar Brahmanon ko bula kar laaya jaye. Diwan itne Brahman dhoondh nahi paaya, isliye usne doosri jatiyon ke kuch logon ko jama kar unhe yagyopavit yaani janeu pehna kar Brahman bana diya tatha bhoj me shamil kar diya. Vidvanon ka vichaar hai ki yah lok-katha Babhans ke apne ko Brahman kehne wale dawe ko samjhane ke liye hi gadhi gayi thi, kyunki asliyat me Babhan ek alag jati ke roop me ban gaye the. Aisi kathayein dikhati hain ki jati-vyavastha me dawe tatha unke samarthan ke liye lok-kathao ka istemal hota tha. Exam point: lok-parampara ke mutabik Magadha ke raja Jarasandha ke Diwan ne ek lakh chalis hazaar Brahmanon ko jutaane ke liye anya jatiyon ke logon ko janeu pehna kar Brahman banaya tha; isi lok-katha se Babhans ke Brahman hone ke dawe ko samjhaya jaata hai.

qe: Among the Muslims of the Patna district, which two groups were the most numerous?
qh: पटना जिले के मुसलमानों में कौन दो समूह सबसे अधिक संख्या में थे?
e: Patna jile ke Mussalman samuday me do samuhon ki upasthiti sabse zyada thi - Sheikhs tatha Jolahas. Inme Sheikh jati ki sankhya sabse zyada thi tatha Jolahas yaani bunakaron ki sankhya usse aadhi ke aas-paas thi. Jolahas mukhya roop se kapda bunne ka kaam karte the, isliye unka rishta shahar ke kapde ke vyapar tatha karkhanon se gahra tha; isi kaaran unka roz ka vyavhar kapde ke vyapariyon tatha karigaron se hota rahta tha. Sheikh tatha Jolahas ke alava bhi kai Mussalman samuh jile me rahte the, lekin unki sankhya kam thi, isliye ganana me sabse zyada sankhya wale hi alag se ginaye jaate the. Aise aankde us daur me vyaparik shaharon ki abaadi ki banawat samajhne me madad karte hain. Exam point: Patna jile ke Mussalmanon me sabse zyada sankhya Sheikhs tatha Jolahas ki thi; Jolahas yaani bunakaron ka mukhya kaam kapda bunna tha; unka sampark Patna ke kapde ke vyapar tatha karkhanon se gahra tha.

qe: Which caste of the Patna district was noted as the most quarrelsome, fond of the lathi and reputed to be audacious cattle stealers?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी जाति सबसे अधिक झगड़ालू, लाठी की शौकीन तथा पशु-चोरी में निडर बताई गई है?
e: Patna jile ki sabse badi jati Goalas yaani Ahir thi. Inke baare me yah bhi darj hai ki ye jile ki sabse zyada jhagda karne wali jati thin; ye baar-baar jhagde tatha dange me shamil hote the tatha lathi chalane me bahut ruchi rakhte the. Unke jhagdon ka ek aam vishay doosron ke pashuon ka apne khet me ghus jaana yaani cattle trespass hota tha. Isi ke saath unhe nidar pashu-chor bhi kaha jaata tha, tatha unme sabse neeche samjhe jaane wale kai log peshe se chor the. Is tarah ek hi jati ke baare me mehnati tatha kifayati hone ki baat tatha jhagde tatha pashu-chori me shamil hone ki baat, dono likhi gayi thi, jo us daur ke samajik varnan ki soch ko dikhati hai. Exam point: Goalas yaani Ahir jati ko jile ki sabse jhagda karne wali jati bataya gaya, jo lathi ki shaukeen tatha pashu-chor ke roop me jaani jaati thi; unke jhagdon ka aam vishay pashuon ka khet me ghusna yaani cattle trespass tha.

qe: The Chamars of the Patna district worked as tanners, and they had a recognised right over the hides of which animals?
qh: पटना जिले के चमार चमड़े का काम करते थे, तथा उनका मान्यता-प्राप्त अधिकार किन जानवरों की खालों पर था?
oe: On the hides of deer and wild animals
On the hides of goats and sheep only
On the hides of dead cattle
oh: हिरण तथा जंगली जानवरों की खालों पर
मरे हुए पशुओं (गाय-बैल) की खालों पर
e: Patna jile me Chamar samuday ka kaam mukhya roop se chamde ka kaam tatha majduri thi, tatha unki samajik sthiti bahut neechi maani jaati thi. Iska karan yah tha ki ve mare hue pashuon ke shareer ke sampark me aate the tatha unhe chhoot ka daag samjha jaata tha. Unka mare hue pashuon ki khalon par manyata-prapt adhikar tha, isliye gaon me koi pashu mara to uski khal unhi ko milti thi. Isi kaaran unpar baar-baar yah shak bhi kiya jaata tha ki ve khal pane ke lalach me pashuon ko zeher de dete the. Bahar se dekha jaye to aise shak ka koi saaf aadhaar nahi tha, lekin samajik sthiti ne unhe aise sandeh ka shikaar bana diya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki jati tatha peshe ka rishta kuch samudayon ke liye samman tatha suvidha, tatha kuch ke liye shak tatha apmaan dono le kar aata tha. Exam point: Chamar samuday chamde ka kaam tatha majduri karta tha tatha mare hue pashuon ki khalon par unka manyata-prapt adhikar tha; isi kaaran unpar pashuon ko zeher dene ka shak kiya jaata tha; unki samajik sthiti chhoot ke kaaran bahut neechi maani jaati thi.

qe: The leather thongs for whips and the fastenings for ploughs used by the villagers of the Patna district were supplied by which caste?
qh: पटना जिले के गाँवकरों को कोड़ों के लिए चमड़े की पट्टियाँ तथा हल की मरम्मत की सामग्री कौन-सी जाति बनाकर देती थी?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me har peshe ka apna nishchit kaam tha, isliye gaon lagbhag aatm-nirbhar maana jaata tha. Chamar samuday ka kaam chamde se judi chhoti-chhoti cheezen banane tatha unki marammat karna tha. Ve gaon ke logon ko kodon ke liye chamde ki pattiyan tatha hal ki marammat ke liye zaruri saamagri dete the; hal ki fastening kharab hone par wohi uski marammat bhi karte the. Iske alava ve gaon me dhindhora yaani village crier ka kaam karte the tatha vivah-adishu rasmon me baja bajate the. Fasl katne ke baad unhe apne yajmanon se anaj tatha fasl ka hissa milta tha, tatha kuch ke paas chhoti jagiren bhi hoti thin. Is tarah ek hi samuday kheti ke auzaar tatha rasmon dono se juda hua tha. Exam point: gaon me kodon ke liye chamde ki pattiyan tatha hal ki fastening tatha uski marammat Chamar samuday karta tha; ve gaon ke dhindhore yaani crier tatha rasmon me baja bajane wale bhi the; fasl ke baad unhe anaj tatha chhoti jagiren milti thin.

qe: In the villages of the Patna district, the word 'chamari' was equivalent to which word, on account of the reputation of the Chamars?
qh: पटना जिले के गाँवों में चमारों की ख्याति के कारण 'चमारी' शब्द किस शब्द के बराबर माना जाता था?
e: Patna jile ke Chamar samuday ke baare me yah likha gaya ki unhe chor samjha jaata tha. Unki chor ki khyaati itni phaili hui thi ki gaon ke log 'chamari' shabd ko 'chori' ke barabar maante the, yaani 'chamari' kehne ka matlab hi chori samjha jaata tha. Iske bawajood unki gaon me ek aisi zarurat thi jiske kaaran unse khul kar takrao nahi hota tha - Chamar ki patni gaon ki dai yaani midwife ka kaam karti thi, isliye logon me yah bhay rahta tha ki unse larai karenge to woh pravas ke samay seva dene se inkar kar degi. Isi kaaran unki ghalat harkatein kuch had tak bina saza ke chal jaati thin. Aisi sthiti dikhati hai ki gaon ki aarthik tatha samajik vyavastha me nimn jatiyon ka sthan kitna jatil tha. Exam point: Chamar samuday ki chor ki khyaati ke kaaran 'chamari' shabd 'chori' ke barabar istemal hota tha; Chamar ki patni gaon ki dai hoti thi, isliye log unse khul kar nahi bhidade the tatha unki harkatein kuch had tak bina saza ke chal jaati thin.

qe: Which caste of the Patna district had a monopoly of making and selling oil, and also had a strong belief that every member of the caste becomes a powerful malignant spirit called Musan after death?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी जाति तेल बनाने तथा बेचने पर एकाधिकार रखती थी तथा यह मानती थी कि मरने पर हर व्यक्ति 'मुसान' नामक बलवान दुष्ट आत्मा बन जाता है?
e: Patna jile me Teli samuday ka pesha parampara se tel nikalna tatha bechna tha tatha is dhandhe par unka ek tarah ka ekadhikar mana jaata tha. Unme bahut se log anaj ke vyapari tatha mahajan bhi ban gaye the. Telis ki dharmik manyata bhi alag thi - unka vishwas tha ki koi bhi Teli, chahe uski maut swabhavik ho ya aswabhavik, mare hue ke baad ek bahut hi shaktishali tatha dushit aatma 'Musan' ban jaata hai. Kaha jaata tha ki Musan ko kisi bhi shareer se bahar nikalne ke liye bahut hoshiyar ojha tatha sabse shaktishali mantron ki zarurat hoti hai. Madari yaani juggler log apne khel ka chinh dikhane ke liye Teli ki khopdi ka istemal karte the, jisse unhe Musan ki sahayata milne ki manyata thi. Aise vishwas dikhate hain ki peshe tatha mrityu ke aas-paas kitni gehri manyataayein bani hui thin. Exam point: Teli samuday ka paramparaagat pesha tel nikalna tatha bechna tha tatha ise bharpur adhikar maana jaata tha; unka vishwas tha ki har Teli mare hue ke baad 'Musan' naam ki bahut shaktishali dushit aatma ban jaata hai; madari log Teli ki khopdi ka istemal apne khel ke chinh ke roop me karte the.

qe: The great doorway at the Buddhist monastery of Nalanda was set up by one Baladitya, described as the chief among the wise men of which clan?
qh: नालंदा के बौद्ध विहार का महाद्वार किस कबीले के 'बुद्धिमानों में मुखिया' कहे गए बलादित्य नामक व्यक्ति ने स्थापित कराया था?
e: Patna jile me Teli samuday keval tel ke dhandhe tak seemit nahi tha; unka itihas aur bhi purana tatha gaurav bhara bataya jaata hai. Kaha jaata hai ki Teli log pehle Bihar me ek bahut shaktishali kabile ke roop me the tatha Telarha, jise pehle Tailadhaka kaha jaata tha, unki shakti ka kendra tha. Nalanda ke Bauddh vihar ka maha-dwar Baladitya naam ke ek vyakti ne khada karwaya tha, jise 'Tailadhaka kabile ke buddhimanon me mukhiya' kaha gaya hai. Isi tarah kaha jaata hai ki Nalanda me jo Buddha ki vishal pratima hai, jise 'Telia Bhandar' ke naam se jaana jaata hai, use bhi ek Teli ne khada karwaya tha tatha Tetrawan me bhi ek badi Bauddh pratima ek Teli ne sthapit karwai thi. In baaton se pata chalta hai ki prachin kaal me Telis ka samajik tatha dharmik yogdan bada tha. Exam point: Nalanda ke Bauddh vihar ka mahadwar Baladitya ne khada karwaya tha tatha use 'Tailadhaka kabile ke buddhimanon me mukhiya' kaha gaya hai; Nalanda ki vishal Buddha pratima 'Telia Bhandar' tatha Tetrawan ki Bauddh pratima bhi Teli logon se judi batayi jaati hai; Telarha ko pehle Tailadhaka kaha jaata tha.

qe: Which popular saying about Bihar, quoted in the account of the Patna district, mentions Muhammadans, Telis and toddy-palms?
qh: पटना जिले के वर्णन में उद्धृत कौन-सी लोकोक्ति बिहार के संबंध में मुसलमानों, तेलियों तथा ताड़ के पेड़ों का जिक्र करती है?
e: Patna jile me Teli samuday ka vyaparik prabhav itna bada tha ki ek lokokti pracharit ho gayi. Us lokokti me kaha jaata tha ki 'Turk, Teli, tar, in tinon Bihar' - yaani Bihar 'Turk' yaani Mussalmanon, 'Teli' yaani tel banane wale vyapariyon tatha 'tar' yaani taad ke pedon - in teeno se bana hua hai. 'Tur' yaani taad ke pedon ka zikr is liye hota tha ki unke ras se tari yaani sharaab banti thi tatha Pasi jati ke log isi kaam par zyada lagte the. Isi lokokti se pata chalta hai ki Teli samuday ka kapde tatha anaj ke bazaar me kitna varchasv tha - likha gaya hai ki jile ka lagbhag poora vyapar unke haath me tha - tatha Mussalman log shahar tatha kasbon ke vyapar me bade paimane par shamil the. Exam point: 'Turk, Teli, tar, in tinon Bihar' lokokti Bihar ko Mussalmanon, Teli samuday tatha taad ke pedon se joda karti hai; jile ka bahut bada hissa vyapar Teli logon ke haath me tha; taad ke ras se tari banti thi tatha Pasi jati ke log isi kaam me lagte the.

qe: Which two divisions of Brahmans were the most numerous in the Patna district?
qh: पटना जिले में ब्राह्मणों के कौन दो वर्ग सबसे अधिक थे?
e: Patna jile me Brahman samuday ki sankhya kaafi thi tatha unke kai varg the; inme sabse zyada do varg the - Sakadwipi tatha Kanyakubja. Sakadwipi varg me kuch zameendar tatha kisan the, lekin ek samuday ke roop me ve logon ke vaidya tatha purohit ka kaam karte the. Kanyakubja varg me zyadatar log Sanskrit tatha Hindi padhane ke kaam me lagte the; inme kuch kheti karne lage the tatha kuch chhote zamindar ban gaye the; inme se bahut garib log rasoiye ka kaam karte the, kyunki koi bhi jati Brahman ke haath ka bana khana kha sakti thi. Inki do upadhiyan thi - Sarwariya tatha Saryupari; ye aam taur par purohit ka kaam nahi karte the, kyunki ve daan-dakshina lete nahi the. Yah baat bhi darj hai ki Brahmans bahut der tak angreji padhne se katrate rahe, jisse unhe clerk jaisi naukriyon ka labh nahi mil paaya. Exam point: Patna jile ke sabse zyada Brahman do varg Sakadwipi tatha Kanyakubja the; Sakadwipi log vaidya tatha purohit ka kaam karte the tatha Kanyakubja zyadatar Sanskrit-Hindi ke shikshak the, kuch kheti karne lage the; Brahmans bahut der tak angreji padhne se katrate rahe tatha unki upadhiyan Sarwariya tatha Saryupari thi.

qe: Besides cultivation, the Dusadhs of the Patna district largely filled which village posts?
qh: खेती के अलावा पटना जिले के दुसाध मुख्यतः किन गाँव-पदों पर लगे होते थे?
oe: Road and village watchmen, goraits and chaukidars
oh: सड़क तथा गाँव के पहरेदार, गोरैत तथा चौकीदार
गाँव का हिसाब रखने वाले पटवारी
e: Patna jile ke Dusadh samuday ki aajivika ka varnan do tarah ka milta hai. Inme se kuch log kheti karte the, lekin bade hisse ne sadak tatha gaon ki chaukidari, gorait ke kaam tatha chaukidar ke pad sanbhale hue the; jinhe koi kaam nahi milta tha tatha jinke paas zameen nahi thi, woh sadharan mazdoor ya hali ban jaate the. Yah bhi darj hai ki yuropiyon ke yahan khana banane wale kai rasoiye Dusadh the. unhe gaon me nidar chor ki khyaati prapt thi, lekin ek dilchasp baat bhi likhi gayi hai - agar kisi ko itna vetan de diya jaata tha ki woh chaukidar ka kaam kare, to uske jaati bhai aksar us gaon ke gharon me chori karne se ruk jaate the. Is tarah chaukidari ka pad gaon ki suraksha tatha Dusadh samuday ki aajivika, dono ke liye mahatvapurn tha. Exam point: Dusadhs kheti ke alava sadak tatha gaon ke pahredar, gorait tatha chaukidar ka kaam karte the; kuch yuropiyon ke rasoiye bhi Dusadh the; unhe chor ki khyaati thi, lekin chaukidar ko theek vetan milne par us gaon me chori kam ho jaati thi.

qe: The worship of Rahu among the Dusadhs was held twice a year on which two days?
qh: दुसाधों में राहु की पूजा वर्ष में दो बार किन दो दिनों पर होती थी?
e: Patna jile ke Dusadh samuday ki puja ka tareeka khaas tha - unme suar ki bali tatha sharaab ka arpan mukhya hota tha, jabki mukhya devta Rahu, Salais, Sokha tatha Goraiya the. Rahu ki puja saal me do baar hoti thi, ek Pus Sankranti ke din tatha doosri Chait Satwani ke din; vivah ke mauke par yah puja bahut dhoom-dham se hoti thi. Iski vidhi is tarah thi ki do baans ke khambhe gadhe jaate the tatha unke aar-paar do talwaren kinare upar ki or rakh kar jodi jaati thin, jisse ek chhoti seedhi jaisi ban jaati thi; in talwaron ke dandon par pujari, jise Bhagat kaha jaata tha, khada ho kar mantr padhta tha tatha do been yaani cane dhanush ki tarah mod kar pakadta tha. Isi ke paas doodh me aate ki goliyan ubaali jaati thin tatha taiyar hone par Rahu ko arpit ki jaati thin. Aise varnan se gaon ke nimn jatiyon ke dharmik jeevan ka saaf chitra milta hai. Exam point: Dusadh Rahu ki puja saal me do baar Pus Sankranti tatha Chait Satwani ke din karte the; pujari ko Bhagat kehte the jo talwaron se bani seedhi par chadh kar mantr padhta tha; doodh me ubaali aate ki goliyan Rahu ko arpit ki jaati thin.

qe: In the worship of Rahu by the Dusadhs, after a fire had been burnt in a shallow pit, who walked over the red-hot embers?
qh: दुसाधों की राहु-पूजा में उथली गड्ढे में आग जलने के बाद लाल तप्ती राख पर कौन चलते थे?
oe: A Brahman, the Bhagat and the man on whose behalf the ceremony was held
Three unmarried girls of the village
The whole village with the zamindar
oh: एक ब्राह्मण, भगत तथा वह व्यक्ति जिसकी ओर से पूजा होती थी
e: Dusadh samuday ki Rahu-puja ki vidhi me ek aur anokha charan bhi tha. Jab do baans ke khambhon tatha talwaron wali rasm poori ho jaati thi, to ek uthli gadde me aag jalai jaati thi; jab woh laal tapti raakh ban jaati thi, to us par teen log chalte the - ek Brahman, doosra Bhagat yaani pujari, tatha teesra woh vyakti jiski or se yah puja ki ja rahi hoti thi. Jab ye teen log jalte koylen par chal lete the, to santan-heen yaani banjh striyan us jalte koyle ke chhote-chhote tukde utha leti thin; unka vishwas tha ki isse unhe santan prapt hogi. Aisi rasmein dikhati hain ki gaon ke nimn samudayon me dharm, andhvishwas tatha jeevan ki aashayein kaise ek saath judi hui thin. Exam point: Rahu-puja me uthli gadde ki tapti raakh par Brahman, Bhagat tatha jis vyakti ki or se puja hoti thi, woh teen log chalte the; iske baad banjh striyan jalte koyle ke tukde utha leti thin kyunki unhe santan ki aasha hoti thi.

qe: Which caste of the Patna district worshipped wolves on the strength of a tradition that a wolf had once carried off a boy of the caste and then given him up?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी जाति इस परंपरा के आधार पर भेडियों की पूजा करती थी कि एक भेडिया उनके एक लड़के को उठा ले गया था और फिर लौटा दिया था?
e: Patna jile ke Kahar samuday ki ek rasm bilkul anokhi thi - ve bhediye yaani wolves ki puja karte the. Is puja ke peeche ek lok-katha thi, jiski katha ke mutabik ek bhediya Kahar samuday ke ek ladke ko utha kar le gaya tha; ladke ke rishtedar uske peeche bhage tatha bhediye ko is baat par manaya ki woh ladke ko wapas kar de. Us din se aisi manyata ban gayi ki Kahars bhediyon ki puja karte hain. Iska anushthan is tarah hota tha ki bachche ke janm ya vivah ke mauke par Kahar log bhoj karte the; us bhoj me kuch bhi khane se pehle thoda khana ek bartan me nikal kar aangan me rakha jaata tha, tatha bhoj samapt hone par us khane ko phenk diya jaata tha. Yah rakha hua khana bhediyon ko arpan maana jaata tha. Aise vishwas dikhate hain ki lok-dharm me jaanvaron tatha purvajon ki ghatnaon ka kitna gehra asar hota tha. Exam point: Kahars bhediyon ki puja karte the, kyunki ek lok-katha ke mutabik ek bhediya unke jati ka ladka utha le gaya tha tatha rishtedaron ke kehne par usne use wapas kar diya; bachche ke janm ya vivah ke bhoj me thoda khana aangan me rakh kar bhoj ke baad phenk diya jaata tha, jo bhediyon ko arpan tha.

qe: In a legend of the Patna district, the Kahars were the builders of which great embankment near Giriak, and were given a daily wage of what by king Jarasandha?
qh: पटना जिले की एक लोक-कथा के अनुसार कहार गिरियक के निकट किस बड़े बंधे के निर्माता थे तथा राजा जरासंध ने उन्हें दैनिक मजदूरी क्या दी थी?
oe: The Kharagpur embankment, with five seers of rice
The Sonepur bund, with two rupees a day
The Pokhra bund, with one seer of gram
The Asurenbandh, with three and a half seers of anaj as daily wage
oh: खरगपुर का बंध, पाँच सेर चावल
सोनपुर का बंध, दो रुपये रोज
असुरेनबंध, तथा दैनिक मजदूरी साढ़े तीन सेर अनाज
e: Patna jile ke Kahar samuday ko Babhans ki tarah Jarasandha ke samay se joda jaata tha. Lok-katha ke mutabik Giriak ke nikat jo bada bandh hai, jise Asurenbandh kaha jaata hai, use banane ka kaam Kahars ne kiya tha. Kaha jaata hai ki Rajkumari ka vivah tatha aadha rajya jeetne ki shart par unhe yah kaam saunpa gaya tha, lekin woh apna kaam poora nahi kar paaye. Raja Jarasandha ne unhe bulaya tatha kaha ki chahe woh uski putri tatha aadha rajya nahi jeet paaye, phir bhi unhone bahut shram kiya hai, isliye woh kuch majduri ke haqdar hain; unhone har aadmi ko saadhe teen seer anaj diya. Us din se aisi manyata chal padi ki Kahar ka ek din ke kaam ka asli vetan saadhe teen seer anaj hai. Aisi lok-kathayein dikhati hain ki jatiyon ke peshe tatha majduri ki dar ka aadhaar purani kathayein bhi hoti thin. Exam point: lok-katha ke mutabik Kahars ne Giriak ke nikat Asurenbandh banaya tha; kaam poora na ho paane par bhi Jarasandha ne har kahar ko saadhe teen seer anaj din ke kaam ka vetan diya tha; isi se yah manyata bani ki Kahar ka din ka vetan saadhe teen seer anaj hai.

qe: Which deity of the Kahars is described as the deified spirit of a dead man, propitiated with offerings of goats when a marriage takes place?
qh: कहारों के किस देवता को मृत व्यक्ति की देवता बनी आत्मा बताया गया है, जिसे विवाह के अवसर पर बकरे चढ़ाकर प्रसन्न किया जाता था?
e: Patna jile ke Kahar samuday kheti karne ke saath-saath palki uthane tatha anya sadharan majduri ka kaam bharpur karte the, tatha inme se bahut log niji naukar bhi the. Unki puja me Bandi, Sokha, Ram Thakur, Panch Pir tatha Manust Deva shamil the. Inme Manust Deva ki puja ka tareeka alag tha - usay kisi mare hue purush ki devta ban chuki aatma maana jaata tha, isliye vivah ke mauke par usay bakre chadha kar prasann kiya jaata tha. Aisi manyata dikhati hai ki ese nam ke devta purvaj-puja ka hi ek roop hote the, jahan kisi purvaj ko devta ka darja de kar unse raksha tatha aashirwad maanga jaata tha. Isi tarah Kahar samuday me mehnat, seva tatha lok-dharm teeno ek saath dikhte hain. Exam point: Kahar samuday ke devta Manust Deva ko mare hue purush ki devta ban chuki aatma maana jaata tha tatha vivah ke avsar par use bakre chadha kar prasann kiya jaata tha; Kahar log palki uthane tatha niji naukri ka kaam bhi karte the.

qe: The Dusadhs of the Patna district were specially reputed as thieves, but their confreres were said to abstain from plundering houses under the charge of whom?
qh: पटना जिले के दुसाध मुख्यतः चोरी के लिए बदनाम थे, लेकिन कहा जाता है कि उनके जाति-भाई उन घरों से लूटमार से बचते थे, जो किसकी देख-रेख में थे?
oh: अच्छी तनखाह पाने वाले दुसाध चौकीदार
e: Patna jile ke Dusadh samuday ke baare me yah kaha jaata tha ki woh sudhare hue chor nahi hai, yaani unme chori ka prachalan aam tha. Lekin isi varnan me ek dilchasp baat bhi likhi gayi hai - yadi kisi gaon me Dusadh samuday ke ek admi ko itna achha vetan de diya jaata tha ki woh chaukidar ka kaam sanbhale, to us gaon ke gharon me uske jaati bhai aksar chori karne se bachte the. Aisa us karz ke kaaran hota tha jo woh apne chaukidar bhai ke prati maante the, kyunki ek ko kaam tatha izzat mili ho to poora samuday us par aanch nahi aane deta tha. Isi ke saath unke rasoiye ke roop me kaam karne ka zikr bhi hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki yuropiyon ke yahan bhi Dusadh log kaam karte the. Exam point: Dusadh samuday ko chor ki khyaati thi, lekin us gaon ke gharon me uske jati-bhai chori nahi karte the jahan kisi Dusadh ko achhi tanakhah par chaukidar bana diya gaya ho; kuch yuropiyon ke rasoiye bhi Dusadh the.

qe: Which caste of the Patna district was described as industrious, peaceful and contented cultivators, in great demand among zamindars and largely cultivating potatoes and country vegetables?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी जाति मेहनती, शांत तथा संतुष्ट किसान बताई गई है, जो ज़मींदारों में बहुत मांगी जाती थी तथा बड़े पैमाने पर आलू तथा देशी सब्जियाँ उगाती थी?
e: Patna jile me kisan jatiyon ki tulna karte hue Koiri samuday ka varnan khaas taur par sarahi jaane wali shreni me milta hai. Koiri log mehnati, shant tatha santusht kisan maane jaate the, isliye zamindar unhe apni zameen par basane ke liye bahut ichhuk rahte the. Ye mukhya faslon ke alava bade paimane par aalu tatha deshi sabziyan ugate the, jo shahar ke bazaar me bik jaati thin. Koiri log Goalas se is maamle me alag the ki woh apna anaj chhup nahi rakhte the - ve behtar anaj khud khate the tatha bhusi apne pashuon ko dete the; ve pashu nahi paalte the, doodh-makkhan nahi bechte the tatha chori bhi nahi karte the. Inme se kuch log shahar me vyapari ban gaye the, jisme unki mehnat ke kaaran ve aksar safal hote the. Yah tulna dikhati hai ki ek hi jile me kisan jatiyon ki aarthik sthiti tatha riti vyavhar alag-alag thi. Exam point: Koiri jati ko mehnati, shant tatha santusht kisan bataya gaya, jise zamindar apni zameen par basane ke liye bahut chahte the; ve mukhya faslon ke saath aalu tatha deshi sabziyan ugate the, doodh ya pashu nahi paalte the tatha kuch shahar me vyapari ban gaye the.

qe: The Rajputs of the Patna district chiefly belonged to which callings, besides being descendants of Rajput soldiers settled early in the district?
qh: पटना जिले के राजपूत, जो पहले बसे राजपूत सैनिकों के वंशज बताए जाते हैं, मुख्यतः किन कामों में लगे थे?
e: Patna jile ke Rajput samuday ke baare me bataya jaata hai ki ve un Rajput sipahiyon ke vanshaj the jo bahut pehle is jile me aa kar bas gaye the. Samay ke saath unka mukhya kaam kheti ban gaya - inme zyadatar sampann kisan tatha kheti ke thekadar the, kuch zamindar tatha mahajan bhi the. Unki purani gaon-samuday vyavastha kuch jagah aaj bhi bachi hui thi, khaas taur par Barh subdivision me aise gaon milte the jahan sabhi log Rajput the - yahan tak ki gaon ka chaukidar bhi Rajput hota tha. Bahut se Rajput khud ko Babhans se shreshth maante the, kyunki Babhans ke Brahman vansh hone ke dawe ko ve nahi maante the. Unki veerta tatha imandari ki khyaati thi, isliye police me unki bharti bade paimane par hoti thi. Exam point: Patna jile ke Rajput mukhya roop se sampann kisan tatha kheti ke thekadar the tatha kuch zamindar-mahajan bhi; Barh subdivision me aise gaon bache the jahan chaukidar tak Rajput tha; veerti tatha imandari ki khyaati ke kaaran police me unki bharti hoti thi.

qe: Why did many Rajputs of the Patna district consider themselves superior to the Babhans?
qh: पटना जिले के बहुत से राजपूत स्वयं को बाबहनों से श्रेष्ठ क्यों मानते थे?
oe: Because they were the village priests
Because they had come from Bengal
Because they did not accept the Babhans' claim to Brahmanical origin
oh: क्योंकि वे गाँव के पुजारी थे
क्योंकि वे अधिक राजस्व देते थे
क्योंकि वे बंगाल से आए थे
क्योंकि वे बाबहनों के ब्राह्मण वंश से होने के दावे को नहीं मानते थे
e: Patna jile me Rajput tatha Babhan dono hi bade zamindar tatha kisan gharane the, isliye dono ke beech darje ka sawal mahatvapurn tha. Babhans apne aap ko Brahman vansh se aaya batate the tatha Brahmanon ki tarah hal nahi chalate the. Lekin bahut se Rajput unka yah dawe nahi maante the tatha khud ko Babhans se shreshth maante the. Rajputs ke baare me likha gaya ki unki purani gaon-samuday vyavastha kuch jagah bachi rahi, khaas taur par Barh subdivision me, jahan poore gaon Rajput hote the. Inki veerta tatha imandari ki khyaati ke kaaran inhe police me bharti kiya jaata tha, isliye unka samajik darja aur uncha ho gaya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki jati-vyavastha me dawe tatha prathistha ke liye aksar aapas me takrao hote the. Exam point: Rajputs Babhans ke Brahman vansh hone ke dawe ko nahi maante the, isliye ve khud ko unse shreshth maante the; Barh subdivision me pure Rajput gaon bache the; veerta tatha imandari ki khyaati ke kaaran Rajputs police me bade paimane par bharti hote the.

qe: The Rajputs of Barh subdivision in the Patna district were organised in villages which were composed entirely of Rajputs, even down to which post?
qh: पटना जिले के बाढ़ अनुमंडल के राजपूतों के वे गाँव थे जिनमें सभी लोग राजपूत थे - यहाँ तक कि कौन-सा पद भी राजपूत के पास था?
e: Patna jile me Rajput samuday ke gaonon ki banawat ek khaas baat thi. Inme kuch gaon purane gaon-samuday ke roop me bache hue the tatha unme sabhi log Rajput the; yahan tak ki gaon ke chaukidar ka pad bhi Rajput ke paas hi hota tha. Aisi vyavastha dikhati hai ki gaon ek samuday ke roop me kitna sakht tha tatha bahari jatiyon ke logon ko un gaon me jagah milna aasan nahi tha. Isi kaaran in gaon me gaon ki suraksha, zameen tatha vivaad sabhi kaam ek hi jati ke log mil kar chalate the. Rajputs apne aap ko Babhans se bhi uncha maante the tatha unki veerta tatha imandari ki khyaati ke kaaran police me unki bharti zyada hoti thi. Aise varnan Magadh kshetra ke gaon-jeevan me jati tatha samuday ke gehere rishte dikhate hain. Exam point: Barh subdivision me aise gaon bache the jahan sabhi log Rajput the tatha gaon ka chaukidar pad bhi Rajput ke paas hota tha; aisi gaon-samuday vyavastha dikhati hai ki jati tatha pesha ka rishta kitna gehra tha; Rajput veerta tatha imandari ki khyaati ke kaaran police me bade paimane par bharti hote the.

qe: In which subdivision of the Patna district did villages composed entirely of Rajputs, including the chaukidar, survive?
qh: पटना जिले के किस अनुमंडल में पूरे राजपूत के बने गाँव - चौकीदार तक राजपूत - बचे रहे थे?
e: Patna jile ke gaon-jeevan me jati ke hisaab se basne ka ek saaf udaharan Barh subdivision me milta hai. Wahan aise gaon milte the jahan sabhi log Rajput the; gaon ki har kheti, har ghar tatha yahan tak ki gaon ka chaukidar bhi Rajput hi hota tha. Yah baat dikhati hai ki us daur me gaon keval gharon ka samooh nahi, balki ek samuday tha jisme ek hi jati ke log milkar zameen tatha suraksha ka prabandh karte the. Isi jile ke anya kshetron me Ganga ke kinare base shahri tatha ardha-shahri ilake the, jahan abaadi tatha peshe mil-jul kar rahte the. Is tarah ek hi jile me alag-alag kshetron ki samajik banawat bilkul alag thi. Exam point: Patna jile ke Barh subdivision me pure Rajput gaon bache the tatha unme chaukidar ka pad bhi Rajput ke paas hota tha; aisi banawat dikhati hai ki gaon ek samuday ke roop me kaam karta tha; jile ke anya kinare-kshetra vyaparik tatha mishrit the.

qe: Being noted for bravery and honesty, the Rajputs of the Patna district were largely employed in which service?
qh: वीरता तथा ईमानदारी के लिए प्रसिद्ध पटना जिले के राजपूत बड़े पैमाने पर किस सेवा में लगे हुए थे?
e: Patna jile me Rajput samuday ki pehchaan do baaton se bani thi - veerta tatha imandari. Inhi gunon ke kaaran ve police me bade paimane par bharti kiye jaate the, kyunki gaon tatha shahar me shaanti banaye rakhne ke liye aise logon ki zarurat hoti thi jo bhay tatha lalach se swayam prabhavit na hon. Isi samuday ka bada hissa kheti me bhi laga hua tha - ve sampann kisan tatha kheti ke thekadar the, kuch zamindar tatha mahajan bhi the. Kuch gaon aaj bhi poore Rajput ke the, jahan chaukidari tak unke paas thi. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi tatha uske baad bhi jati tatha peshe ka rishta Bharat ke gaon-jeevan me kitna gehra tatha tikao wala tha. Exam point: Rajput veerta tatha imandari ke kaaran police me bade paimane par bharti kiye jaate the; unka bada hissa kheti, thekadari, zamindari tatha mahajani me bhi laga hua tha; pure Rajput gaonon me chaukidari tak unke paas hoti thi.

qe: Which caste of the Patna district was almost entirely occupied in tapping toddy trees and selling the tari liquor?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी जाति लगभग पूरी तरह ताड़ के पेड़ों से रस निकालने तथा ताड़ी (शराब) बेचने में लगी हुई थी?
e: Patna jile ki Pasi jati ka mukhya kaam taad ke pedon se ras nikalna tatha usse bani taadi yaani deshi sharaab bechna tha. Jo log is kaam me nahi lag paate the, woh mukhya roop se mazdoor ban jaate the tatha kuch log thodi kheti bhi karte the. Is samuday ki ek khaas rasm bhi thi - Pasi log purab ki hawa yaani east wind ko prasad chadhaate the, taaki unka taadi ka mausam achha rahe tatha unhe bharpur ras mile. Yah baat dikhati hai ki us daur me mausam tatha hawa ke rukh par nirbhar peshe kaise apni-apni ritiyan banate the. Aage ke jilon me Pasi jati ko jamin tatha naukri ke maamle me bahut peechhe rakha gaya, isliye unki aarthik haalat kamzor hi rahi. Exam point: Patna jile ke Pasis taad ke pedon se ras nikalne tatha taadi ke vyapar me lagbhag poori tarah lage huye the; jo is kaam me nahi lag paate the woh mazdoor ya chhote kisan bante the; is jati me purab ki hawa ko prasad chadhaane ki rasm thi, taaki unka taadi ka mausam achha rahe.

qe: The Dhanuks of the Patna district were, by occupation, chiefly what?
qh: पटना जिले के धानुक मुख्यतः किस पेशे के थे?
oe: Diggers and excavators, and workers on embankments
oh: अनाज भूनने तथा मिठाई बेचने वाले
खोदने-कुरेदने वाले मज़दूर तथा बाँध पर काम करने वाले
e: Patna jile ke Dhanuk samuday ka mukhya pesha khodai ye kaam tatha bandhon, pule-jaise nirman par majduri tha. Unki utpatti ke baare me sthanik lok-katha me yah kaha jaata tha ki ve un Kurmi logon ke vanshaj hain, jinhone apne aap ko ghulam ki tarah bech diya tha; lekin unke naam se hi yah saaf hota hai ki unka naam 'dhanush' yaani kamand se bana hai, isliye vidvanon ka vichar hai ki ve kisi aise samuh ke vanshaj hain jo non-Aryan janjati se nikla tha. Colonel Waddell ne yah baat nikaali ki Patna shahar ke jo bade ilake purane lakdi ke parkot se jude hue the, wahan lagbhag sabhi log Dhanuk the; isi aadhaar par unhone kaha ki Dhanuk log purane Pataliputra ki pracheer par pahra dene wale purane sipahiyon ke vanshaj ho sakte hain. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki jati tatha peshe ka rishta kaise purane shahar ki banawat se juda hua tha. Exam point: Dhanuk jati ka mukhya pesha khodai tatha bandhon par majduri tha; lok-katha me unhe Kurmi ghulamon se joda jaata tha, lekin unka naam batata hai ki ve asal me dhanurdhar the tatha kisi non-Aryan janjati se nikli jati ke vanshaj ho sakte hain; Patna ke purane lakdi parkot wale ilake me Dhanuk hi zyada the, isliye unhe Pataliputra ke pracheer ke purane sipahiyon ka vanshaj maana jaata hai.

qe: Who pointed out that the small wards of Patna city adjoining the old wooden walls of ancient Pataliputra consist almost exclusively of Dhanuks, and suggested they are descendants of the old soldiery?
qh: पटना नगर के जिन छोटे मोहल्लों पर पुराने पाटलिपुत्र की लकड़ी की दीवारें लगी थीं, वहाँ लगभग केवल धानुक रहते हैं - यह किसने बताया तथा उन्हें पुराने सैनिकों का वंशज माना?
e: Patna shahar ke purane ilake ke baare me Colonel Waddell ne ek mahatvapurn baat batayi - shahar ke woh chhote mohalle, jahan prachin Pataliputra ka lakdi ka parkot hua karta tha, wahan lagbhag sabhi log Dhanuk jati ke the. Is baat ko dekh kar unhone anuman lagaya ki Dhanuk log un purane sipahiyon ke vanshaj hain, jinhone prachin samay me in pracheero tatha burjon ki pahra-dari ki thi. Is samuday ka naam bhi is anuman ko bal deta hai, kyunki 'Dhanuk' shabd 'dhanush' se bana hai, jiska arth kamand hai; isse lagta hai ki pehle ye log sahasi tila halper tatha hathyar chalane wale the. Samay ke saath unka pesha khodai tatha bandhon par majduri ban gaya. Aise tark dikhate hain ki aaj ka pesha purane samay ki raksha-vyavastha ka avshesh ho sakta hai. Exam point: Colonel Waddell ne dikhaya ki Pataliputra ke purane lakdi parkot ke paas ke mohalle me lagbhag sabhi log Dhanuk the tatha yah baat unke purane sipahiyon ke vanshaj hone ka sanket deti hai; 'Dhanuk' naam dhanush yaani kamand se bana hai; aage chalkar unka pesha khodai tatha bandhon ki majduri ban gaya.

qe: The Kandus of the Patna district were the grain parchers of the district; which deity has a temple at Nawada (Khusrupur) in the Barh subdivision and is specially worshipped by them?
qh: पटना जिले के कांदू अनाज भूनने का काम करते थे; किस देवता का मंदिर बाढ़ अनुमंडल के नवादा (खुसरुपुर) में है जिसकी ये विशेष रूप से पूजा करते हैं?
e: Patna jile ke Kandu samuday ka mukhya pesha anaj bhunna tha; iske alava ve bhuna hua anaj, mithai tatha aise hi padarth bechte the tatha kuch log majduri bhi karte the. Unke dharmik jeevan me Ganinath ki puja ka khaas sthan tha. Ganinath ka ek mandir Barh subdivision ke Nawada (Khusrupur) me tha tatha anya jagahon par ghar ke devta-ghar me bhi unki puja hoti thi. Bahut si anya nimn jatiyon ki tarah ye log bhi bimari ko dushit aatmaon yaani demoniacal possession ka parinaam maante the. Isliye ilaj ke liye ve ojha ko bulate the; ojhe ka tareeka yah tha ki woh ek kabootar maarta tha tatha uspar deshi sharaab tatha apne khoon ki ek boond daalta tha, tatha mantr padh kar us dushit aatma ko us kabootar ke shareer me se bahar nikal deta tha. Aise vishwas dikhate hain ki gaon ki chikitsa dharmik riti-riwaj tatha ojha-sayana se judi hui thi. Exam point: Kandu anaj bhunne ka kaam karte the tatha bhuna anaj tatha mithai bechte the; Ganinath ka mandir Barh subdivision ke Nawada (Khusrupur) me tha tatha kandu log Ganinath ki puja karte the; bimari ko dushit aatma ka asar maan kar ojha kabootar maarkar uspar sharaab tatha apne khoon ki boond daal kar mantr padhta tha.

qe: The Hajjams of the Patna district were by profession barbers attached to certain families, a not unusual payment being how much grain per adult per annum?
qh: पटना जिले के हज्जाम पेशे से नाई थे, जो कुछ परिवारों से जुड़े होते थे; एक वयस्क के पीछे प्रतिवर्ष सामान्य भुगतान कितना अनाज होता था?
e: Patna jile me Hajjam yaani nai log peshe se hajamat karne ka kaam karte the tatha woh kuch nishchit parivaron se jude hote the; unka bhugtan aksar anaj me hi hota tha tatha ek vayask ke peechhe saal bhar ka samanya vetan das seer anaj mana jaata tha. Kuch Hajjamon ke paas chhoti jagiren bhi hoti thin. Ve vivah tatha anya rasmon ke nimantran pahunchane tatha panchayat bulaane ka kaam bhi karte the, jiske badle unhe paisa ya anaj milta tha. Fasl katne ke samay unke yajmanon me se har kisan se unhe thoda anaj lena manya tha, isliye achhe mausam me unke paas khane laayak anaj hamesha rahta tha; lekin bacha hua paisa tatha puraji nahi hone ke kaaran zarurat ke samay unke paas koi sahaara nahi hota tha. Jo log yuropiyon tatha amir bharatiyon ke paas kaam karte the, unhe nakad vetan milta tha, jisse woh kuch bacha bhi paate the. Exam point: Hajjam nai logon ka bhugtan mukhya roop se anaj me hota tha tatha ek vayask ke peechhe saal ka samanya vetan das seer anaj tha; ve rasmon ke nimantran pahunchane tatha panchayat bulaane ka kaam bhi karte the tatha fasl par unhe har kisan se thoda anaj milta tha; puraji na hone ke kaaran zarurat ke samay unke paas koi madad nahi hoti thi.

qe: The Barhis of the Patna district were carpenters who formed a recognized part of the village community; about how much grain were they given for each plough they made or mended?
qh: पटना जिले के बढ़ई गाँव के समुदाय का मान्य हिस्सा माने जाते थे; प्रत्येक हल बनाने या ठीक करने पर उन्हें लगभग कितना अनाज दिया जाता था?
oe: About a maund of grain a year
e: Patna jile ke Barhi log peshe se badhai yaani carpenter the tatha gaon ke samuday ka ek manya hissa maane jaate the. Unka mukhya kaam gaon walon ke liye hal yaani plough tatha anya kheti ke auzaar banane tatha unki marammat karne ka tha. Unka bhugtan kuch anaj tatha kuch kind yaani vastuon ke roop me hota tha, tatha us daur ka aam hisaab yah tha ki har hal banane ya theek karne ke peechhe unhe lagbhag ek man anaj saal bhar me milta tha. Kheti ke auzaar ke bina kisan ka kaam nahi chalta tha, isliye Barhi jati gaon ki aarthik vyavastha ka zaruri ang thi. Isi tarah gaon me lohar, dhobi tatha nai jaise kai karigar peshe ke hisaab se bant chuke the, jisse gaon lagbhag aatm-nirbhar ban jaata tha. Exam point: Barhi log badhai ka kaam karte the tatha gaon samuday ka manya hissa the; ve gaon ke kisanon ke liye hal tatha kheti ke auzaar banate tatha theek karte the; is kaam ke badle unhe har hal ke peechhe lagbhag ek man anaj saal bhar me milta tha.

qe: The Kayasths, the writer caste of Bihar, had a special festival on which they worshipped their pen and ink. What was it called?
qh: बिहार की लेखक-जाति कायस्थों का एक विशेष पर्व था, जिसमें वे अपनी कलम तथा दवात की पूजा करते थे। उसे क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Patna jile me Kayasth samuday Bihar ki lekhak yaani writer jati mana jaata tha. Inki sankhya pachchis hazaar se kuch zyada thi tatha ye bade paimane par sarkari daftaron me kaam karte the; inme se kai log police me writer-constable tatha unche adhikari ban jaate the. Kayasth log vyapar ko neecha maante the tatha unme apne darje ka kaafi abhimaan tha. Unke ghar ke sanskar tatha rasmein bahut kharchile tareeke se hoti thin, chahe unki aarthik haalat aam taur par kamzor hi rahti thi. Inka ek khaas tyohar tha 'Dawat Puja', jisme ve apni kalam tatha davat yaani syahi-dani ki pooja karte the tatha us din poora avakash maante the. Aise tyohar dikhate hain ki kaam tatha peshe ko dharma se kaise joda jaata tha. Exam point: Kayasth Bihar ki lekhak jati thi tatha ve sarkari daftaron me tatha police me writer-constable tatha unche adhikari ke roop me kaam karte the; ve vyapar ko neecha maante the tatha unme darje ka abhimaan zyada tha; unka khaas tyohar Davat Puja tha, jisme ve kalam tatha davat ki puja karke avakash maante the.

qe: Bhojpuri, Maithili and Magahi, the main regional languages of Bihar, belong to which family of languages?
qh: बिहार की मुख्य क्षेत्रीय भाषाएँ भोजपुरी, मैथिली तथा मगही किस भाषा-परिवार से संबंधित हैं?
e: Bhojpuri, Maithili tatha Magahi teeno 'Bihari bhashaon' ke naam se jaani jaane wali bhashayein hain tatha yeh Indo-Aryan (bharat-europeeya) parivar ki sanskrit se nikli bhashayein hain; inka vyakaran, shabd-avali tatha muhavare bahut milte hain, isliye bahar wale unhe ek doosre ki 'bahan' samajh lete hain. Maithili ka kshetra Mithila (Darbhanga, Madhubani, Saharsa, Purnia tak) hai tatha yah bharat ki aathvin anusuchi me shaamil bhasha hai; Bhojpuri ka kshetra pashchim Bihar tatha Poorvanchal me hai tatha Magahi ka kshetra Patna, Gaya, Nalanda, Nawada aadi Magadh jilon me hai. Hindi ke saath-saath Maithili tatha Bhojpuri jaisee bhashayein Bihar ke bade kshetron me boli jaati hain. Dravidian parivar ki bhashayein (Tamil, Telugu, Kurukh) tatha Austro-Asiatic (Santali, Mundari) alag parivar hain - isliye sahi uttar Indo-Aryan hai. Exam point: Bhojpuri, Maithili tatha Magahi = Indo-Aryan parivar ki Bihari bhashayein; Maithili aathvin anusuchi me shaamil; Magahi ka kshetra Magadh (Patna, Gaya, Nalanda) tatha Maithili ka kshetra Mithila hai.

qe: Angika, a regional language of Bihar, is associated with which historical region?
qh: बिहार की क्षेत्रीय भाषा अंगिका किस ऐतिहासिक क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: Angika bhasha ka naam prachin Anga rajya se aaya hai; Anga ka kshetra aaj ke Bhagalpur, Banka, Munger, Jamui tatha aas-paas ke jilon me phaila hua hai tatha uski pehli rajdhani Champa thi. Is kshetra me boli jaane wali bhasha ko Angika kaha jaata hai tatha yah apni alag shabd-avali tatha lok-geeton ke liye jaani jaati hai; yahi kshetra Manjusha chitrakala tatha Bihula-Bishari lok-katha ka bhi kshetra hai. Magadh kshetra ki bhasha Magahi, Tirhut ki Maithili tatha Saran-Chhapra kshetra ki lok-boli Bhojpuri ki or jhukti hai - isliye in vikalpon ka mel Angika se nahi hota. Isi tarah Mithila kshetra ki anya boli Bajjika kehlati hai, jo Maithili tatha Hindi ke beech ki kadi maani jaati hai. Isliye Angika ke liye sahi uttar Anga kshetra hai. Exam point: Angika bhasha = Anga kshetra (Bhagalpur, Banka, Munger, Jamui); Anga ki rajdhani Champa thi tatha yahi kshetra Manjusha kala tatha Bihula-Bishari lok-katha ka hai; Bajjika bhasha Mithila kshetra se judi hai.

qe: In Bihar, along with Hindi as the official language, which language has the status of a second official language?
qh: बिहार में हिंदी के साथ राजभाषा के रूप में किस भाषा को द्वितीय राजभाषा का दर्जा प्राप्त है?
e: Bihar me rajya ki rajbhasa Hindi hai tatha 1989 me rajya sarkar ne Urdu ko 'dvitiy rajbhasa' (second official language) ka darja diya; iska arth yah hai ki sarkari kaam-kaj me Urdu ka bhi upyog kiya ja sakta hai tatha Urdu me aavedan-sikayat di ja sakti hai. Urdu Bihar me kisi ek kshetra ki bhasha nahi balki shehri ilaakon me bade paimane par boli jaati hai; iski shabd-avali sanskrit, arabi tatha farsi ka mel hai, isliye ise Hindustani sanskriti ka hissa maana jaata hai. Census 2011 me Bihar me Hindi ke baad sabse zyada bolne wali bhasha Urdu hi thi (lagbhag 8.4 pratishat log). Maithili aathvin anusuchi me shaamil hone ke bawajood Bihar me dvitiy rajbhasa nahi hai; Bhojpuri tatha Sanskrit ko bhi yah darja nahi mila - isliye sahi uttar Urdu hai. Exam point: Bihar ki rajbhasa = Hindi, dvitiy rajbhasa = Urdu (1989 se); Census 2011 me Bihar me Hindi ke baad sabse adhik boli jaane wali bhasha Urdu (lagbhag 8.4%); Maithili aathvin anusuchi me hai, lekin Bihar ki dvitiy rajbhasa nahi.

qe: Kurukh, the language of the Oraon tribe, belongs to which language family?
qh: उराँव जनजाति की भाषा कुरुख किस भाषा-परिवार की है?
e: Oraon (Kurukh) logon ki bhasha Kurukh hai tatha yah Dravidian parivar ki bhasha hai; iska hona is baat ka sabse bada pramaan hai ki bharat me Dravidian bhasha bolne wale log poore desh me phaile the tatha aaj bhi madhya-purab ke aadivasi kshetron me unki bhashayein bachi hui hain. Kurukh ko 'Kurux' bhi likha jaata hai tatha yah Hindi se bilkul alag dhaanche wali bhasha hai, isliye Oraon kshetra ke bachche school me Hindi sikhne me kathinai mehsoos karte hain. Hindi, Bhojpuri tatha Magahi Indo-Aryan hain, Santali tatha Mundari Austro-Asiatic hain tatha tibbato-burmi bhashayein Himalaya ke kshetra me boli jaati hain. Isi tarah Munda bhasha Mundari tatha Santhalon ki bhasha Santali Austro-Asiatic parivar me aati hai, jo southeast Asia ki bhashaon se rishta rakhti hain. Isliye sahi uttar Dravidian hai. Exam point: Kurukh (Oraon) = Dravidian parivar; Santali tatha Mundari = Austro-Asiatic (Munda) parivar; yah antar pariksha me poochha jaata hai kyunki ek hi kshetra me alag parivaron ki bhashayein boli jaati hain.

qe: Santali, spoken by the Santhal community, belongs to which family of languages?
qh: संथाल समुदाय द्वारा बोली जाने वाली संताली किस भाषा-परिवार से संबंधित है?
e: Santali Santhal aadivasi samuday ki bhasha hai tatha yah Austro-Asiatic (Munda) parivar me aati hai; is parivar ki bhashayein southeast Asia tatha bharat ke madhya-purabi kshetra me bhari sankhya me boli jaati hain. Santali ki apni lipi 'Ol Chiki' hai, jise 20vein sadi me Pandit Raghunath Murmu ne banaya; isse pehle yah bhasha kagaz par likhne ke liye kisi anya lipi ka sahara leti thi. Santali ko bharat ke samvidhan ki aathvin anusuchi me bhi shaamil kiya gaya (92vein sanshodhan, 2003), jisme Maithili, Bodo tatha Dogri aadi bhashayein bhi jodi gayi. Kurukh (Oraon) Dravidian hai tatha Hindi-Magahi-Bhojpuri Indo-Aryan hain, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi hain. Yeh antar isliye mahatvapurn hai kyunki ek hi ilaake ke aadivasi samuday alag-alag bhasha-parivaron ki bhashayein bolte hain. Exam point: Santali = Austro-Asiatic (Munda) parivar, Santhal samuday ki bhasha, lipi 'Ol Chiki' (Raghunath Murmu), aathvin anusuchi me 2003 (92vein sanshodhan) me shaamil; Kurukh Dravidian parivar ki hai.

qe: In Census 2011, the Scheduled Tribe population of Bihar formed roughly what share of the state's total population?
qh: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार बिहार की अनुसूचित जनजाति आबादी राज्य की कुल जनसंख्या का लगभग कितना हिस्सा थी?
e: Census 2011 me Bihar ki anusuchit janjati (Scheduled Tribe) jansankhya lagbhag 13.36 lakh thi, jo rajya ki kul jansankhya 10.41 crore ka keval lagbhag 1.3 pratishat hai - isliye Bihar un rajyon me aata hai jahan aadivasi jansankhya ka hissa bahut kam hai. Iski ek badi vajah 15 November 2000 ko hui rajya ka vibhajan hai, jab aadivasi-bahul Chotanagpur kshetra alag ho kar Jharkhand rajya ban gaya tatha Bihar me aadivasi jansankhya bahut kam bach gayi. Bihar me aadivasi log mukhya roop se un jilon me rahte hain jo Jharkhand ki seema se lage hain, jaise Kaimur, Rohtas, Aurangabad, Gaya, Nawada, Jamui, Banka tatha Bhagalpur, tatha Pashchim Champaran ke terai kshetra me Tharu log rahte hain. Anusuchit jati ki jansankhya isse kai guna badi hai (lagbhag 15.9 pratishat), isliye in dono sankhyon ko mila dena aam galti hoti hai. Isliye sahi uttar 'lagbhag 1.3 pratishat' hai. Exam point: Census 2011 me Bihar ki ST jansankhya lagbhag 13.36 lakh = kul jansankhya ka lagbhag 1.3 pratishat; iska karan 2000 me Chotanagpur kshetra alag hokar Jharkhand banna; SC jansankhya iske ulta lagbhag 15.9 pratishat hai.

qe: Which of the following sets of communities are Scheduled Tribes found in Bihar?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा समुदाय-समूह बिहार में पाई जाने वाली अनुसूचित जनजातियों का है?
e: Bihar ki mukhya anusuchit janjatiyon me Tharu, Oraon, Munda, Santhal, Kharwar, Kora tatha aadi samuday shaamil hain; inme Tharu log mukhya roop se Pashchim Champaran ke terai (Valmikinagar) kshetra me rahte hain tatha unki apni bhasha Tharu hai. Oraon, Munda tatha Santhal jaisi janjatiyan mukhya roop se rajya ke Jharkhand-seema wale jilon me milti hain tatha unki bhashayein Kurukh, Mundari tatha Santali alag-alag bhasha-parivaron ki hain. Yadav, Kurmi tatha Rajput jaise samuday 'pichhda varg' (OBC) ki suchi me aate hain, janjati nahi; isi tarah Teli, Kalwar, Barhai tatha Lohar OBC ya anya pichhde vargon me gine jaate hain tatha Bania-Kayastha-Brahmin samanya varg ke samuday hain. Isliye janjati ki sahi jodi Tharu, Oraon, Munda tatha Santhal hai. Exam point: Bihar ki mukhya janjatiyan = Tharu (Pashchim Champaran terai), Oraon, Munda, Santhal, Kharwar aadi; SC-ST-OBC ki suchiyan alag hain, isliye Yadav-Kurmi-Rajput ko janjati likhna galti hai.

qe: Tharu, a Scheduled Tribe of Bihar, is mainly found in which part of the state?
qh: बिहार की अनुसूचित जनजाति थारू मुख्यतः राज्य के किस भाग में पाई जाती है?
oe: The Terai belt of West Champaran
The Kosi flood plain of Saharsa
e: Tharu janjati mukhya roop se Pashchim Champaran jile ki Nepal-seemawali terai patti me rahti hai, khaas taur par Valmikinagar tatha uske aas-paas ke jangal tatha khet kshetra me; yah un thodi Bihar janjatiyon me hai jo Himalaya ke neeche nami wale kshetra me basi hain. Tharu logon ka apna lok-jeevan, ghar ki banawat tatha lok-geet bhi unki pehchan hain. Terai ki nami wali hawa tatha machharon wale kshetra me rahne ke karan unki rog-pratirodhak kshamta bhi adhyayan ka vishay rahi hai. Kosi ka baadh-maidan, Magadh ka pathar tatha Begusarai ka tal kshetra alag bhogolik kshetra hain, jahan anya samuday rahte hain, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi hain. Isi liye Tharu ke liye sahi uttar Pashchim Champaran ki terai patti hai. Exam point: Tharu janjati = Pashchim Champaran ki terai patti (Valmikinagar kshetra), Nepal ki seema se lagti hui; terai ke nami wale mahaul me rahti hai tatha apni alag bhasha tatha lok-parampara rakhti hai.

qe: Which language, other than Hindi, is returned by a large number of speakers in Bihar in the Census and stands second in the state?
qh: जनगणना में बिहार में हिंदी के अलावा किस भाषा को बोलने वालों की संख्या बड़ी है तथा वह राज्य में दूसरे स्थान पर आती है?
e: Census me Bharat me har vyakti apni 'mother tongue' bataata hai; Bihar me sabse zyada log Hindi ko apni bhasha batate hain tatha uske baad sabse badi sankhya Urdu bolne walon ki hai (lagbhag 8.4 pratishat). Iska karan yah hai ki Urdu shehri kshetron tatha kayi kasbon me bade paimane par boli tatha samjhi jaati hai, khaas taur par Purnia, Katihar, Araria, Kishanganj, Darbhanga, Muzaffarpur tatha Patna ke ilaakon me; 1989 me Bihar me Urdu ko dvitiy rajbhasa ka darja bhi mila. Santali, Kurukh tatha Nepali bhashayein bhi Bihar me boli jaati hain, lekin unke bolne walon ki sankhya bahut kam hai; Maithili tatha Bhojpuri ko bahut se log Hindi ke andar hi likhwa dete hain, isliye unki alag ginti kam dikhti hai. Isliye Hindi ke baad doosre sthan par Urdu hi aati hai. Exam point: Census me Bihar me Hindi ke baad doosre sthan par Urdu (lagbhag 8.4 pratishat); Urdu ko 1989 me Bihar ki dvitiy rajbhasa banaya gaya; Santali-Kurukh-Nepali bhashayein sankhya me bahut kam hain.

qe: The country at Saren is said to have formerly belonged to the Bundawats, who called themselves Rajputs and many of whom still live in Pargana Chay in Ramgarh; before the Bundawats it belonged to which people?
qh: सरेन का इलाक़ा पहले बुंदावतों का कहा जाता है, जो स्वयं को राजपूत कहते थे तथा जिनमें से बहुत से अब भी रामगढ़ के परगना चय में रहते हैं; बुंदावतों से पहले यह इलाक़ा किस जाति का था?
e: Saren tatha uske aas-paas ke ilaqe me basne wale logon ke bare me bataya jaata tha ki yah ilaqa pehle Bundawaton ka tha, jo svayan ko Rajput kehte the tatha jinme se bahut se log ab bhi Ramgarh ke Pargana Chay me rehte hain; ve Hindi bolte the tatha shuddh bhojan karte the. Bundawaton se pehle yah ilaqa Kol logon ka mana jaata tha; Kol aur Cheru alag-alag log maane jaate the, tatha Palamu ka Raja ek Cheru bataya jaata tha. Kaha jaata tha ki Bundawat tatha Kol log is ilaqe se poori tarah nikal diye gaye (banished) the; unke baad bhi yahan Bhungiya jaise log badee sankhya me bache hue the. Pattharon aur khandaharon ke saath-saath aise varnan us ilaqe ke purane nivasiyon tatha unke rajkulon ki jankari dete hain. Exam point: Saren ka ilaqa pehle Bundawaton ka tha, jo svayan ko Rajput kehte the tatha jinke kai log Ramgarh ke Pargana Chay me rehte hain; unse pehle yah ilaqa Kol logon ka tha, Kol aur Cheru alag-alag the tatha Palamu ka Raja ek Cheru mana jaata tha.

qe: Though the Bundawats and the Kol are said to have been entirely banished from the country about Saren, which people were stated to remain there in large numbers?
qh: सरेन के आसपास के इलाक़े से बुंदावत तथा कोल लोगों के पूरी तरह निकाल दिए जाने के बाद भी वहाँ कौन-सी जाति बड़ी संख्या में बची हुई बताई गई?
e: Saren ke aas-paas ke ilaqe ki aabadi ke bare me vivran-karta ne likha ki yahan Bundawat tatha Kol logon ko poori tarah nikal diya gaya, lekin uske baad bhi yahan Bhungiya jaise bahut se log bache hue the. Isi kshetra me Narawat ki pahadi tatha Tapaban shreni ke beech ka bhaag lagbhag aadha bhara hua tha, jise Goyala log jitna ho sake banjar yaani waste rakhne ka prayas karte the. Yah kshetra ka ghan jungle tatha pathreela bhi bataya gaya. Aise vivran dikhate hain ki unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me bhi yah kshetra purane mansoon aur adivasi samudayon ka kendra tha, jahan patthar ke khandahar tatha kivdantiyan dono sath-sath milte the. Exam point: Bundawat tatha Kol logon ke nikalne ke baad bhi Saren ke aas-paas Bhungiya logon ki bahut sankhya bachi hui thi; Narawat pahadi tatha Tapaban shreni ke beech ka bhaag Goyala logon dwara jitna ho sake banjar rakha jaata tha.

qe: Among the Sravakas of Rajgir, which caste was not admitted at all, though any man could become a Sravaka?
qh: राजगीर के श्रावकों में किस वर्ण-समूह को बिल्कुल प्रवेश नहीं दिया जाता था, जबकि कोई भी पुरुष श्रावक बन सकता था?
e: Sravak shabd Jain dharm ke anuyayi logon ke liye prayog hota tha. Rajgir ke Sravak logon ki jati-vyavastha ke baare me yah bataya gaya ki unme kuchh Sravak Brahman the, kuchh Kshatriya aur kuchh Vaishya, lekin Shudron ko bilkul pravesh nahi tha; haan, koi bhi purush chahe uske purvaj Jain the ya nahi, Sravak ban sakta tha. Jetti ya Guru keval teen shuddh varnon me se hi banaya ja sakta tha. Unki manyata thi ki unki sabhi 31 jatiyan Vaishya hain, jabki dakshin aur pashchim me bahut se Kshatriya hain; woh Brahmanon ke sabhi devtaon ki pooja bhi karte the. Exam point: Rajgir ke Sravak logon me Shudron ko pravesh nahi tha, jabki teen shuddh varnon me se koi bhi Sravak tatha Jetti ya Guru ban sakta tha.

qe: Under the Hindu marriage customs of Bihar, which caste married its daughters when they were no more than four to five years old?
qh: बिहार में हिंदू विवाह रीति-रिवाजों के अनुसार कौन-सी जाति अपनी पुत्रियों का विवाह तब करती थी जब वे चार से पाँच वर्ष से अधिक की नहीं होती थीं?
e: Bihar me Hindu vivah riti-riwaz bahut purane the tatha bal-vivah yaani child marriage unka ek pramukh ang tha. Khatris tatha Kayasthas infant marriage yaani shishu-vivah karte the, Brahmanas apni putriyon ka vivah tab karte the jab woh char se paanch saal se zyada ki nahi hoti thin, agrawals unka vivah nau saal ki umar me karte the. Nichli Sudra jatiyon me Behlars infant marriage karte the tatha Bihar ke Dhobis apni putriyon ka vivah paanch se barah saal ke beech karte the. Aam taur par nichli jatiyon me ladkiyon ka vivah pehle hi, aksar paanch saal se kam umar me, ho jaata tha. Unnisvin sadi tak yeh pratha uchh vargon me vyapak thi, lekin shikshit vargon me aaj yeh lagbhag khatm ho gayi hai. Exam point: Bihar me Brahmanas char se paanch saal ki umar me, Agrawals nau saal me tatha Khatris tatha Kayasthas shishu-avastha me apni putriyon ka vivah karte the.

qe: In Bihar, the ornament called 'kanausi' was usually worn by men of which districts?
qh: बिहार में 'कनौसी' नामक आभूषण सामान्यतः किन जिलों के पुरुष पहनते थे?
e: Pashchimi yaani European fashion ka asar badhne se pehle Bihar me kapdon tatha gehnon ke purane riwaz hi chalte rahe. Unnisvin sadi ki shuruat me angreji-padhe log tatha uchh European afsaron ke sampark me aane wale log European fashion ki nakal karne lage, lekin mahilaen is mamle me bahut dheemi thin tatha unme bahut kam log is prabhav me aayin. Bihar me purush aam taur par dhoti, pyjama, kurta ya shirt pehente the; padhe-likhe log trousers aur shirt ya bush-shirt pehente the tatha kuchh log poora European dress pehente the. Gehne purush kam hi pehente the tatha jo pehente the unme Shahabad me 'bala' ya 'bali', Patna tatha Gaya me 'kanausi' tatha Gwalas me 'kundal' pramukh tha; mala yaani motiyon ki mallayen bhi pehni jaati thin. Exam point: Purushon me Shahabad ka 'bala' ya 'bali', Patna tatha Gaya ka 'kanausi' tatha Gwalas ka 'kundal' mukhya gehne the, jabki mala ya bead necklaces bhi pehne jaate the.

qe: In the fourfold division of Rigvedic society, which three were the 'twice-born' (dwijas)?
qh: ऋग्वैदिक समाज के चतुर्वर्ण विभाजन में 'द्विज' कौन-से तीन थे?
e: Varna ka arth hai Rigvedic samaj ka chaar hisso me vibhajan, jisme teen dwija yaani twice-born the - Brahmana, Kshatriya tatha Vaisya - tatha chaturth varg Sudra tha, jiske neeche outcastes yaani jati-bahishkrit log aate the. Dwijas ko twice-born isliye kehte the kyunki unka ek doosra janm maana jaata tha, jo upanayan yaani initiation samskar se hota tha; is samskar me woh pavitra dhaaga yaani sacred thread dharan karte the, jo unhe aadhyatmik anushasan ke jeevan me pravesh ka prateek maana jaata tha. Prachin samay me upari teen vargon me ek varga se doosre me jaana sambhav tha, lekin aage chalkar yeh gatishilta bahut kam ho gayi. Exam point: Dvija yaani twice-born teen the - Brahmana, Kshatriya tatha Vaisya; unhe dwija isliye kaha jaata tha kyunki upanayan samskar me woh pavitra dhaaga yaani sacred thread dharan karte the tatha Sudra tatha outcastes unse neeche maane jaate the.

qe: In Bihar, the gift of houses, lands, ponds and orchards to a temple in perpetuity was a means of support for whom?
qh: बिहार में किसी मंदिर को घर, भूमि, तालाब तथा बाग स्थायी रूप से दान करना किसके भरण-पोषण का साधन था?
oe: The priests in charge of the temple
e: Brahmanas apne aap ko sabse uchh jati maante the tatha samaj me unhe anya jatiyon se upar sthan prapt tha. Yeh sthan mukhya roop se isliye tha ki woh dharm ke adhikari maane jaate the tatha purohiton ko milne wala samman unhe milta tha, lekin sabhi Brahman purohit nahi the - kai jatiyon ke apne purohit the tatha purohit sanyasi vargon se bhi liye jaate the. Kuchh Brahman us samman se jeete the jo tyoharon tatha utsavon ke samay unke aadhyatmik sanrakshan me aaye parivaron se milta tha. Mandiron ko ghar, zameen, taalaab, baghche aadi sthayi roop se daan karne se us mandir ke prabhari pujariyon ka bharan-poshan hota tha; badle me daan dene wale mandir ke devta ki apni or se puja ki apeksha karte the. Kuchh Brahman Sanskrit padha kar, jyotish bhavishyavani, shubh-ashubh din batakar tatha hathel dekhar apna jeevan-yapan karte the; hazaaron Brahman vyapar, kheti, sena tatha sarkari daftaron me kaam karke guzara karte the; kuchh ne nichli jatiyon ke purohit ka kaam karke ya shraddha samarohon me daan lene wale Kantaha ya Mahapatra ka pad lekar apni samajik sthan kam kar liya tha. Exam point: Mandiron ko ghar, zameen, taalaab tatha baghche ka sthayi daan mandir ke pujariyon ke bharan-poshan ka sadhan tha tatha shraddha me daan lene wale Kantaha ya Mahapatra ke pad se Brahmanon ka samajik sthan gir jaata tha.

qe: In the child marriages of Hindu Bihar, the rite amounted to a betrothal because the marriage was actually consummated only when?
qh: हिंदू बिहार के बाल-विवाह में रस्म वस्तुतः सगाई जैसी थी, क्योंकि वास्तविक दाम्पत्य जीवन कब शुरू होता था?
oe: Only after the girl had reached the age of maturity
Immediately on the day of the marriage rite
As soon as the bride-price was fully paid
Only after the first harvest festival of the family
oh: केवल तब, जब लड़की परिपक्वता की आयु तक पहुँच जाती थी
विवाह की रस्म वाले दिन ही तुरंत
दहेज पूरी तरह चुकाए जाने पर
परिवार के पहले फसल त्योहार के बाद ही
e: Bihar ke Hindu samaj me bal-vivah ho jaane ka arth keval sagai yaani betrothal tha, yani usse poora daampatya jeevan shuru nahi hota tha. Vivah ki rasmein poori hone ke baad bhi patni apne pati ke ghar nahi jaati thi tatha na hi uske saath rahti thi; yeh sab tab tak sambhav nahi tha jab tak woh paripakvta ki ayu yaani maturity tak na pahunch jaye. Isliye kaha jaata hai ki bal-vivah asal me sagai ke samaan tha tatha ladkiyon ke jaldi vivah hone ke bawajood kanoon tatha parampara dono ke hisaab se unka daampatya jeevan paripakvta ke baad hi shuru hota tha. Yahi vyavastha yeh bhi dikhati hai ki samaj me bachpan ki shadiyon ki samasya keval rasmon tak simit nahi thi, balki umar tatha swasthya se juda ek gambhir vishay thi. Exam point: Hindu bal-vivah keval sagai ke saman tha; patni paripakvta ki ayu tak pati ke ghar nahi jaati thi, isliye vivah ki rasmein poore hone ke turant baad daampatya jeevan shuru nahi hota tha.

qe: In the customs of which district was it said that no orthodox Hindu would drink water from a girl's hand unless she was tattooed?
qh: किस जिले की रीति में कहा गया था कि कोई रूढ़िवादी हिंदू किसी लड़की के हाथ से पानी तब तक नहीं पीएगा जब तक उसका गोदना न हुआ हो?
e: Bihar ki mahilaon ke jeevan me gehne tatha shringar ka bahut mahatva tha. Jo mahilaen kharch utha sakti thin woh sugandhit tel yaani aromatic oils lagati thin tatha bahut se gehne pehnti thin. Baalon ko dhone tatha unhe alag-alag tarikon se sajaane par vishesh dhyan diya jaata tha. Tattooing yaani godna badi prachlit pratha thi. Purnea me kaha jaata tha ki koi bhi rurhivadi yaani orthodox Hindu kisi ladki ke haath se paani nahi piyega jab tak uski godna na ho chuki ho. Aise vishwas dikhate hain ki us samay sharirik chinha tatha shringar keval sundarta tak simit nahi the, balki samajik manyata tatha vaivahik jeevan se bhi jude the. Exam point: Godna yaani tattooing Bihar me badi prachlit pratha thi tatha Purnea me rurhivadi Hindu ladki ke godna hone se pehle uske haath se paani nahi peete the.

qe: Which statement about varna, caste and community in Bihar is correct?
qh: बिहार में वर्ण, जाति तथा समुदाय के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
oe: The caste system was found only among Hindus and never among Muslims or Christians
Every varna still has one common origin, one common occupation and complete intermarriage
Varna is the old fourfold division, while each varna today is a collection of many separate castes
Varna and caste mean exactly the same thing in practice
oh: जाति प्रथा केवल हिंदुओं में थी, मुसलमानों या ईसाइयों में कभी नहीं
प्रत्येक वर्ण का आज भी एक ही सामान्य मूल, एक ही व्यवसाय तथा पूर्ण अंतर्विवाह है
वर्ण प्राचीन चतुर्वर्णीय विभाजन है, जबकि आज प्रत्येक वर्ण कई अलग-अलग जातियों का समूह है
वर्ण तथा जाति व्यवहार में बिल्कुल एक ही अर्थ रखते हैं
e: Jati yaani caste ki avadharna bahut mushkil hai, kyunki alag-alag samay tatha sthanon me iska arth badalta raha. Jati ki aisi paribhasha dena mushkil hai jo poore Bharat par lagoo ho; jaise Rajputon ka koi ek samanya mul nahi hai, uchh jatiyon ki koi samanya jatiya sangathan nahi hai, peshe apni marzi se chune ja sakte hain tatha ek jati ke sabhi sadasy ek saath kha-pi nahi sakte ya aapas me vivah nahi kar sakte. Varna aur jati ek cheez nahi hain: Varna Rigvedic samaj ka chatuh-vibhajan hai, lekin aaj ka har varna kai jatiyon ka samuh hai. Brahmanon me Sakaldwipi Brahmana, Maithili tatha Gayawal me kuchh bhi samanya nahi hai; isi tarah Rajput, Kshatriya tatha Khatri bilkul alag-alag jatiyan hain. Jati pratha keval Hinduon tak simit nahi thi; woh Muslim samaj me bhi milti hai tatha dharmantaran ke peedhiyon baad bhi Christian samuday me zinda rahti hai. Exam point: Varna chatuh-vibhajan hai jabki aaj har varna kai jatiyon ka samuh hai; jati pratha Muslim tatha Christian samudayon me bhi payi jaati hai tatha har jati ka ek samanya mul ya pesha nahi hota.

qe: Along with Brahmanical titles, which Rajput titles were used by the Babhans of Bihar?
qh: ब्राह्मणीय उपाधियों के साथ बिहार के बाभन किन राजपूत उपाधियों का प्रयोग करते थे?
e: Babhans Bihar ki ek badi tatha prabhavshali jati rahi hai. Unke paas Brahmanical gotra, upadhiyan, parivarik naam tatha usi tarah ke riwaz the. Woh Misra, Pandey tatha Tiwari jaise Brahmanical upadhiyon ke saath-saath Rai, Singh tatha Thakur jaise Rajput upadhiyon ka bhi istemaal karte the tatha Brahman ke liye nirdharit aadhi rasmein hi karte the. Shahabad me unhe wahi pranam milta tha jo aam taur par Brahmanon ke liye hota tha, lekin dakshin ki or yeh pratha ajnabi thi; Shahabad me Kayastha ko pehla pranam Babhan hi karta tha. Unka samajik sthan jagah-jagah alag tha - dakshin-purvi Bihar me woh Kayasthon ke turant neeche the, lekin Shahabad tatha Saran me Rajputon ke barabar. Unke upnaam yaani sectional naam do tarah ke the - kshetriy yaani territorial tatha eponymous, jisme eponym aam taur par koi Vedic rishi hota tha. Unke mukhya peshe kheti hai tatha zyadatar Babhan zamindar hain, jinhone Rajputon ki tarah Raja tatha Maharaja jaise laukik upadhiyan dharan kar li hain. Exam point: Babhans Misra, Pandey tatha Tiwari jaise Brahmanical upadhiyon ke saath Rai, Singh tatha Thakur jaise Rajput upadhiyan bhi use karte the tatha Shahabad me unhe Brahmanon wala pranam milta tha.

qe: In which district did a rich Sudra lose his caste for permitting his daughter to remain single up to the age of eighteen?
qh: किस जिले में एक धनी शूद्र ने अपनी पुत्री को अठारह वर्ष की आयु तक अविवाहित रहने देने के कारण अपनी जाति खो दी?
e: Bihar ke Hindu samaj me apni putriyon ka vivah kar dena maa-baap ka ek pramukh dharmik kartavya maana jaata tha. Purnea me ek dhanvan Sudra ne apni putri ko atharah saal ki ayu tak avivahit rehne diya, jiske karan usne apni jati yaani caste kho di. Isse pata chalta hai ki us samay ladkiyon ke vivah me vilamb ko samajik aparadh ke saman dekha jaata tha. Nichli jatiyon me ladkiyon ka vivah aam taur par pehle, aksar paanch saal se kam umar me ho jaata tha, tatha sabhi vargon me vivah ka samay nirdharit karne me samajik dabav bada karan tha. Aise udaharan dikhate hain ki jati vyavastha keval vivah ke niyamon tak simit nahi thi, balki parivar ke vyaktigat nirnayon par bhi sakht niyantran rakhti thi. Exam point: Purnea me ek dhanvan Sudra ne apni putri ko atharah saal ki umar tak avivahit rehne dene ke karan apni jati kho di thi, jo us samay vivah me vilamb par lagaye jaane wale kathor samajik bandhan ko darshata hai.

qe: In the ornaments and make-up of Bihari women, what were 'tikali' and 'bindi' respectively?
qh: बिहारी महिलाओं के आभूषण तथा श्रृंगार में 'टिकली' तथा 'बिंदी' क्रमशः क्या थीं?
oe: A nose ring and an ear ornament made of gold
A toe ring and an anklet made of silver
A waist chain and a wrist bangle
A silver spot placed on the forehead and a round one placed between the forehead and the eyebrows
oh: सोने की नथ तथा कान का आभूषण
कमर की जंजीर तथा कलाई का कंगन
माथे पर लगने वाली चाँदी की टिकली तथा माथे और भौंहों के बीच लगने वाला गोल चिह्न
e: Bihar ki mahilaon me shringar ki ek samridh parampara thi. Vivahit mahilaen apne mathhe tatha maang ke baant me sindur yaani vermillion lagati thin. 'Tikali' ek chandi ka chihn tha jo mathhe par lagaya jaata tha tatha 'bindi' ek gol chihn thi jo mathhe tatha bhaunhon ke beech lagaya jaata tha. Hindu tatha Muslim dono mahilaon ki palaken yaani eyelids 'kajal' ya surma naamak antimony ki tayari se rangeen ki jaati thin. Gale me sone tatha chandi ki kai zanjeeren hoti thin, jinme chandrahar, tilri, panchlari, satlari tatha sikri prakar ki mallayen shaamil thin. Baazuon, kalaiyon, kuhniyon tatha ungliaon ke liye alag-alag gehne the tatha kamar aur pair bhi gehnon se khali nahi the; kamar ke neeche ke gehne aam taur par chandi ke hote the. Exam point: Tikali mathe par lagne wala chandi ka chihn thi tatha bindi mathhe aur bhaunhon ke beech lagne wala gol chihn tha; palaken kajal ya surma se rangeen ki jaati thin.

qe: The Dom caste of Bihar was divided into many occupation-based sub-castes. Which of them bred silkworms?
qh: बिहार की डोम जाति कई व्यवसाय-आधारित उपजातियों में बँटी थी। इनमें कौन रेशम के कीड़े पालती थी?
e: Jati ke andar ki chhoti antarvivahik ikaiyan yaani subcastes banti hain. Up-jati banne ke kai karan hote hain - kisi kshetra me lambe samay tak bas jaana, kisi apmaanjanak yaani degrading peshe ko apnana ya chhod dena, peshon me antar, samajik riwazon me badlav, jati ke ek hisse dwara paida kiya gaya bhrashtapan, jati ki sangathan samiti me vibhajan, ya ek hisse ki doosre se adhik samriddhi. Dom jati apne peshe ke aadhaar par kai upjatiyon me banti thi: Banukia resham ke kide paalte the, Dai-Dom ki mahilaen dai ka kaam karti thin, Tapaspuria mare hue sharir hataate the tatha chita ke neeche ki khai khaudte the, Asera ghaas katte the, Kalindi kisaan the, Kaura suar paalte the, Bansphor baans ki tokriyan banate the tatha Chapanya chhat ki baans-ki-jaali yaani bamboo frames banate the. Risley ne jati ki tulna niche darje ke jeev se ki, jo vibhajan ya cell division se badhta hai. Exam point: Dom jati ke Banukia upjati resham ke kide paalti thi tatha Risley ne jati ki tulna aise jeev se ki jo cell division yaani vibhajan se badhta hai.

qe: How many sub-castes did the Kayasthas of Bihar have, and what was notable about their women?
qh: बिहार के कायस्थों की कितनी उपजातियाँ थीं तथा उनकी स्त्रियों में क्या उल्लेखनीय था?
oe: Twenty sub-castes, and their women worked only as cooks
Twelve sub-castes, and their women could write and some managed their own zamindaris
Seven sub-castes, and their women were forbidden to read
Twelve sub-castes, and their women acted as priests
oh: बीस उपजातियाँ, तथा उनकी स्त्रियाँ केवल रसोइए का काम करती थीं
बारह उपजातियाँ, तथा उनकी स्त्रियाँ लिख सकती थीं और कुछ अपनी जमींदारियाँ चलाती थीं
सात उपजातियाँ, तथा उनकी स्त्रियों को पढ़ने की मनाही थी
बारह उपजातियाँ, तथा उनकी स्त्रियाँ पुरोहित का काम करती थीं
e: Kayasthas Bharat ke likhakar yaani scribes the tatha adhiktar sthanon par darje ke maamle me woh Brahmanon se kam nahi the. Unka samajik sthan unki sampatti tatha sarkari prabhav ke saath lagatar badhta gaya. Bihar me Kayasthon ki barah upjatiyan thin. Peshe ke roop me woh Bharat ke vidwan-abhijat yaani learned aristocracy the. Itna hi nahi, unki mahilaen bhi likh sakti thin tatha unme se kuchh apni jamindariyan khud chala sakti thin. Unki shiksha tatha parishram ki aadaton se mili yogyataon ko alag-alag tarikon se maanyata milti thi. Kuchh zilon me unka patwari ke pad par ikadhikar yaani monopoly tha. Padhne-likhne ka gyaan maangne wale sabhi daftaron me - sena tatha desh ke secretaryon tatha clerkon se lekar sabse nichle gaon ke registrar tak - Kayasth hi milte the. Unme se bahut se log kheti karke bhi guzara karte the, lekin unme se keval sabse gareeb hi apne haathon se hal chalate the; kuchh Kayasth lal shisha yaani red lead banane ke kaarigar bhi the tatha Purnea ke kuchh Srivastavas vyapari, chintz chhapaai karne wale tatha darzi the. Exam point: Bihar ke Kayasthon ki barah upjatiyan thin tatha unki mahilaen likh sakti thin, jisme kuchh apni jamindariyan khud chalati thin; kuchh zilon me unka patwari ke pad par ikadhikar tha.

qe: The most prevalent rule of exogamy in Bihar, 'sapinda', prohibited marriage between parties who had common ancestors up to how many generations?
qh: बिहार में बहिर्विवाह का सबसे प्रचलित नियम 'सपिंड' उन पक्षों के बीच विवाह को प्रतिबंधित करता था, जिनके सामान्य पूर्वज कितनी पीढ़ियों तक थे?
oe: Two generations on the mother's side and none on the father's
Seven or five generations on the father's side and five or three on the mother's
Three generations on both the father's and the mother's side
Ten generations on the father's side and ten on the mother's
oh: माता की ओर दो पीढ़ियाँ तथा पिता की ओर कोई नहीं
पिता की ओर सात या पाँच पीढ़ियाँ तथा माता की ओर पाँच या तीन पीढ़ियाँ
पिता तथा माता दोनों की ओर तीन पीढ़ियाँ
पिता की ओर दस तथा माता की ओर दस पीढ़ियाँ
e: Bihar me vivah ko niyantrit karne ke kai niyam the. Sabse aam niyam yeh tha ki har vyakti ko apni hi up-jati yaani subcaste ke andar vivah karna hoga. Bahirvivah yaani exogamy un logon ke beech vivah ko rokta tha jo ek hi purvaj se utpann maane jaate the ya jo kisi ek kshetriya samuday se jude the. Jahan gotra yaani paramparik samanya purvaj hote the, wahan gotra exogamy aam niyam thi, lekin yeh mukhya roop se Brahmanon, Rajputon tatha anya uchh jatiyon me hi prachlit thi. Sabse prachlit niyam 'sapinda' tha, jiske tahat un pakshon ke beech vivah varjit tha jinke purvaj pita ki or saat ya paanch pidi tak tatha mata ki or paanch ya teen pidi tak samanya the. Exam point: Bihar me sabse prachlit exogamy niyam sapinda tha, jo pita ki or saat ya paanch pidi tatha mata ki or paanch ya teen pidi tak samanya purvajon wale pakshon me vivah rokta tha.

qe: In the caste customs of Bihar, the practice of higher castes taking wives from the lower castes was called by which name?
qh: बिहार की जाति प्रथाओं में उच्च जातियों द्वारा निम्न जातियों की कन्याओं से विवाह करने की प्रथा को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Uchh jatiyon dwara nichli jatiyon ki ladkiyon se vivah karne ki pratha ko anuloma yaani hypergamy kehte the tatha ise vivah ka ek achha roop maana jaata tha. Iske ulat pratiloma, yani nichli jati ke purush ka uchh jati ki ladki se vivah, samajik niyam ke virudh maan kar varjit tha. Anuloma pratha ke karan kai bar dulha ke badle dulhan ka mulya yaani bridegroom-price lena shuru ho gaya, kyunki uchh varg ke var kam padte the tatha unki maang zyada thi. Bihar me badhte var-mulya ko ek badi samajik burai maana gaya tatha ise kanoon dwara hataane ke prayas safal nahi hue; keval prabal janta ki raay hi isse nipat sakti thi. Exam point: Uchh jatiyon dwara nichli jati ki kanya se vivah anuloma yaani hypergamy kehlata tha tatha iska ulat pratiloma varjit tha; anuloma ke karan var-mulya yaani bridegroom-price ki pratha badhi.

qe: In the Bania community of Bihar, which caste stood at the head and ranked immediately below the Brahmanas and the Kayasthas?
qh: बिहार के बनिया समुदाय में कौन-सी जाति शीर्ष पर थी तथा ब्राह्मणों और कायस्थों के ठीक नीचे आती थी?
e: Chaturth varg Vaisya ke antargat Bihar me kai alag-alag jatiyan aati thin. Bania samuday me sabse upar Agarwals ka sthan tha; woh Bihar me anaaj, kapda tatha gehnon ka vyapar karte the tatha saahukar yaani bankers tatha soodkhor yaani usurers ka kaam bhi karte the. Unme se kuchh zamindar tatha bhoomi-dharak the, kuchh bahi-khata rakhne wale tatha dalal bhi the. Bihar me unka darja Brahmanon tatha Kayasthon ke turant baad aata tha. Agarwal se neeche Maheshwari, Purawar tatha Barnwal aadi shreniyan thin tatha Bihar ke Baniyon me teesra darja Rauniyar, Rastogi, Mahuri aadi ka tha. Is tarah Vaisya varg ke andar bhi upari tatha nichli shreniyon ka ek vistrit kram bana hua tha. Exam point: Bihar ke Bania samuday me Agarwals sarvochch the tatha Brahmanon tatha Kayasthon ke turant baad aate the; unke neeche Maheshwari, Purawar tatha Barnwal aadi aate the.

qe: Among which Brahmanas of Bihar did a complete system of hypergamy exist, for which they were divided into a number of groups in descending order?
qh: बिहार के किन ब्राह्मणों में अनुलोम विवाह की पूरी व्यवस्था थी, जिसके लिए उन्हें अवरोही क्रम में कई समूहों में बाँटा गया था?
e: Bihar me uchh jatiyon ke purush nichli jatiyon ya up-jatiyon ki ladkiyon se vivah karte the; is pratha ko hypergamy yaani anuloma kehte the tatha ise vivah ka ek achha roop maana jaata tha. Maithil Brahmanon me hypergamy ki ek poori vyavastha thi, jiske liye unhe avarohi yaani descending kram me kai samuhon me baanta gaya tha. Uchh samuhon ke purush nichle samuhon me vivah karte the, jiske badle unhe kaafi dhan diya jaata tha. Lekin aise purushon ki samajik pratishtha kam ho jaati thi tatha aise mel se paida huye bachhe apne pita ke varg ke saman samajik darja nahi paate the, yadyapi woh apni mata ke asli varg se uncha maane jaate the.
