Bihar me yeh niyam Bengal se adhik udar yaani lax tha. Exam point: Maithil Brahmanon me hypergamy ki poori vyavastha thi tatha is hetu unhe avarohi kram me kai samuhon me baanta gaya tha; aise vivahon ke bachhe pita ke varg ke samajik darje ke barabar nahi maane jaate the.

qe: In the caste government of the lower castes of Bihar, what did a 'Chatai' literally mean and what did it connote?
qh: बिहार की निचली जातियों की जाति-व्यवस्था में 'चटाई' का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या था तथा यह किस बात की सूचक थी?
oe: A lamp, denoting the right to preside over the panchayat
A mat, denoting those who had the right to sit together at a caste council meeting
A flag, denoting the right to lead a caste procession
A drum, denoting the right to summon the caste assembly
oh: दीपक, जो पंचायत की अध्यक्षता के अधिकार को दर्शाता था
चटाई, जो उन लोगों को दर्शाती थी जिन्हें जाति परिषद की बैठक में एक साथ बैठने का अधिकार था
झंडा, जो जाति की सवारी का नेतृत्व करने के अधिकार को दर्शाता था
ढोल, जो जाति सभा बुलाने के अधिकार को दर्शाता था
e: Nichli jatiyon me jati-governance yaani jati-raj ki ek sangathit vyavastha thi. Iski ikai 'Chatai' thi, jiska shabdik arth 'chatai' yaani mat hota hai. Yeh shabd un logon ko darshata tha jinko jati parishad yaani caste council ki baithak me ek saath baithne ka adhikar tha. Chatai ka kshetra is baat par nirbhar karta tha ki kisi sthan par jati kitni sankhya me hai. Pratyek Chatai me ek sthayi samiti hoti thi jisme ek, do ya teen padadhikari hote the. Dakshin Bihar me mukhiya ko Sardar kaha jaata tha, upadhyaksh ko Manjan tatha teesre sadasya ko Chharidar; Chharidar Sardar ka sandesh-vahak hota tha, jo panchayat bulata tha tatha uske nirnayon ko lagu karane ka zimmedar tha. Kuchh panchayaton me yeh pad vanshanugat hote the tatha kuchh me jeevan bhar ke liye chune jaate the; yeh pad priya the kyunki inme pratishtha tatha adhikar hota tha. Exam point: Chatai ka shabdik arth chatai yaani mat hai tatha yeh un logon ko darshata tha jinko jati parishad ki baithak me ek saath baithne ka adhikar tha; Dakshin Bihar me mukhiya Sardar, upadhyaksh Manjan tatha sandesh-vahak Chharidar kehlata tha.

qe: Which caste of South Bihar had the exclusive monopoly of firing brick kilns and did not accept food from Doms, Dusadhs, Dhobis, Chamars and Mehtars?
qh: दक्षिण बिहार की कौन-सी जाति को ईंट की भट्ठियाँ जलाने पर अनन्य एकाधिकार था तथा जो डोम, दुसाध, धोबी, चमार और मेहतर के हाथ का भोजन स्वीकार नहीं करती थी?
e: Mushahar jati dakshin Bihar me kaafi sankhya me milti hai. Woh kai upjatiyon me banti hai tatha sambhavtah unka mul ek janjatiya yaani tribal tha. Unke mukhya peshe hain - ausadhiya jadi-bootiyon, shahad tatha gond ka sangrah tatha bikri, resham ke kide paalna tatha paalki dhona. Eent ki bhattiyon yaani brick kilns ko jalane par unka anya yaani exclusive ikadhikar tha. Woh Dom, Dusadh, Dhobi, Chamar tatha Mehtar ke haath ka bhojan svikar nahi karte the. Aaj ke samay me dakshin Bihar me kheti-mazdoori yaani agricultural labour ka bahut bada hissa Mushaharon dwara hi kiya jaata hai. Is tarah unki gaon ki aarthik vyavastha me ek vishesh bhoomika rahi hai, bhale hi unka samajik darja nimn tha. Exam point: Dakshin Bihar me Mushaharon ko eent ki bhattiyon yaani brick kilns jalane par exclusive ikadhikar tha, woh ausadhiya jadi-bootiyan, shahad, gond, resham tatha paalki ke kaam karte the tatha Dom, Dusadh, Dhobi, Chamar tatha Mehtar ke haath ka bhojan svikar nahi karte the.

qe: The custom of a bridegroom-price gained notoriety among which section of Bihar, whose bridegrooms raised their prices in proportion to the demand and to the risk of forfeiting their titles to property?
qh: वर-मूल्य की प्रथा बिहार के किस वर्ग में कुख्यात हो गई, जिसके वर माँग तथा संपत्ति पर अपने अधिकार खोने के जोखिम के अनुपात में अपना मूल्य बढ़ाते थे?
e: Bihar me vivah me dahej ya bride-price ke saath-saath var-mulya yaani bridegroom-price ki pratha bhi thi. Aam taur par dahej uchh jatiyon me tatha kuchh nichli jatiyon me bhi diya jaata tha tatha iski raashi pakshon ki samajik pratishtha, var ki umar, ladki ke saundarya tatha gunon par nirbhar karti thi. Var-mulya yaani bridegroom-price ki pratha 'Kulin' varg me kukhyat ho gayi, kyunki unke var apni maang tatha sampatti par apne adhikar yaani titles khone ke jokhim ke anupat apna mulya badha dete the. Yeh pratha samajik drishti se ek badi buri yaani evil maani gayi tatha Bihar me ise hataane ke liye kanoon banane ke prayas safal nahi hue; keval prabal janta ki raay hi isse nipat sakti thi. Exam point: Var-mulya yaani bridegroom-price ki pratha Bihar ke Kulin varg me kukhyat thi, jinke var maang tatha sampatti ke title khone ke jokhim ke anupat apna mulya badhaate the.

qe: In North Bihar the head of the panchayat unit was called a Mandal; a number of Mandals were headed by a Sardar whose secretary was known as what?
qh: उत्तर बिहार में पंचायत इकाई के मुखिया को मंडल कहा जाता था; कई मंडलों के प्रमुख सरदार होते थे, जिसके सचिव को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Bihar ke jati-panchayaton ki sanrachna Uttar tatha Dakshin Bihar me alag-alag thi. Dakshin Bihar me mukhiya Sardar, upadhyaksh Manjan tatha teesra padadhikari Chharidar hota tha. Uttar Bihar me panchayat ikai ke mukhiya ko 'Mandal' kaha jaata tha; kai Mandalon ke pramukh Sardar hote the, jiske sachiv ko 'Barik' ya 'Diwan' kaha jaata tha. In sab ke upar 'Raisi' hota tha, lekin samay ke saath Sardar ka pad purana yaani obsolete hota ja raha tha. Panchayat ke padadhikariyon ko kuchh jagahon par fees milte the: Purnea me Dusadhon ke samuh ko kapde ka tohfa milta tha, Goala Raja ko jo panchayaton ki adhyakshta karta tha kapda tatha ek rupya milta tha, tatha Chharidar ko vasoolee gayi rashi par ek ya do aane ka commission milta tha. Banka ke Chamaron me Sardar ko panchayat ki aay ka chautha hissa milta tha tatha shesh bhoj par kharch hota tha. Exam point: Uttar Bihar me panchayat ikai ke mukhiya Mandal, sabhi Mandalon ke pramukh Sardar tatha uske sachiv Barik ya Diwan kehlate the, jabki sabse upar Raisi pad hota tha.

qe: Which caste of Mithila presented the most glaring instance of polygamy in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में बहुविवाह का सबसे चौंकाने वाला उदाहरण मिथिला की किस जाति में मिलता था?
e: Hindu dharm ke siddhanton me purush kai vivah kar sakta tha, lekin vyavahar me yeh uchh jatiyon ke un logon tak simit tha jo ek se adhik patniyon ka kharch utha sakte the. Babhans do patniyan kar sakte the tatha patniyon ki sankhya unki poshan-shamta par nirbhar karti thi. Bihar me polygamy yaani bahu-vivah ka sabse chaunkane wala udaharan Mithila ke Kulins me milta tha. Aam taur par Bihar ke zyadatar log ek hi patni ke saath yaani monogamous the, kyunki bahu-vivah se parivar me jhagde badhte the. Muslims ko char patniyon ki anumati thi, lekin Bihar me unme bhi bahu-vivah aam nahi tha. Exam point: Bihar me bahu-vivah ka sabse bada udaharan Mithila ke Kulins me milta tha; Babhans do patniyan kar sakte the tatha Muslims ko char patniyon ki anumati thi, lekin bahu-vivah aam nahi tha.

qe: Expulsion from a caste in Bihar meant abstaining from which activities with the expelled person?
qh: बिहार में जाति से बहिष्कार का अर्थ बहिष्कृत व्यक्ति के साथ किन गतिविधियों से विरत रहना था?
oe: Eating, drinking, smoking, marrying and holding any social intercourse
Only dining and marriage with the person's family
Only attendance at religious ceremonies with the person
Only trade and money dealings with the person
oh: खाना, पीना, धूम्रपान, विवाह तथा किसी भी प्रकार का सामाजिक संबंध
केवल उसके परिवार के साथ भोजन तथा विवाह
केवल उसके साथ धार्मिक अनुष्ठानों में सम्मिलित होना
केवल उसके साथ व्यापार तथा धन का लेन-देन
e: Jati se bahishkar yaani expulsion sabse kathin saza thi. Iska arth tha ki jati ke log bahishkrit vyakti ke saath khana, peena, dhoomrapan, vivah tatha kisi bhi tarah ka samajik sambandh rakhna band kar dete the. Yeh saza un logon par di jaati thi jinhone jati ko kalankit kiya ho - jaise avyabhicharita yaani unchastity, samudra ke paar videsh ki yatra, varjit bhojan karna, nichli jati ki mahilaon ke saath sambandh banana tatha gaay ki khale jaise varjit padarthon ka vyapar karna. Is saza ka niyam niyamit yaani ceremonial code tatha jati sangathan dwara lagu hota tha, na ki samanya naitik kanoon dwara; kai bar bade niyam tod dene par bhi saza nahi hoti thi, lekin koi maamuli riwaz bina irada todne par bhi saza mil jaati thi. Bahishkar kadwa tha, lekin bahishkrit vyakti poori tarah bahari nahi ban jaata tha tatha uski jati me wapasi yaani readmission ki ek poori prakriya thi; agar bahishkar sthayi ho jaata to unke vanshaj ek nayi upjati bana lete the. Exam point: Jati se bahishkar ka arth tha bahishkrit vyakti ke saath khana, peena, dhoomrapan, vivah tatha samajik sambandh chhod dena; yeh saza avyabhicharita, samudra-paar yatra tatha varjit bhojan jaise karnon par di jaati thi tatha wapasi ki prakriya maujud thi.

qe: Hindu marriages in Bihar were generally performed at the house of the bride; but in certain places such as Mithila, what special custom was followed?
qh: बिहार में हिंदू विवाह सामान्यतः वधू के घर होते थे; लेकिन मिथिला जैसे कुछ स्थानों पर कौन-सी विशेष प्रथा का पालन होता था?
oe: The bride and the bridegroom exchanged their families after the rites
The bride was taken to the bridegroom's house on the very day the marriage was performed
The bridegroom lived in the bride's house for one full year
The marriage was performed only in a temple and not in any house
oh: रस्मों के बाद वधू तथा वर अपने परिवार बदल लेते थे
विवाह होने के उसी दिन वधू को वर के घर ले जाया जाता था
वर पूरे एक वर्ष तक वधू के घर रहता था
विवाह किसी घर में नहीं, केवल मंदिर में होता था
e: Bihar me vivah aam taur par vadhu yaani dulhan ke ghar me hi kiya jaata tha tatha vivah ki rasmein poori hone ke baad dulhan ko var ke ghar le jaaya jaata tha. Lekin is mamle me riwaz jagah-jagah tatha jati-dar-jati badalte the. Mithila jaise kuchh sthanon me dulhan ko vivah ke usi din var ke ghar le jaaya jaata tha, jabki anya jagahon me woh kuchh samay baad apne pati ke ghar jaati thi. Iske alawa jahan bal-vivah hota tha wahan ladkiyan apne pati ke ghar tab tak nahi jaati thin jab tak woh paripakvta ki ayu tak na pahunch jayein. In riwazon se pata chalta hai ki Bihar me vivah ke samay tatha jagah ko lekar samajik niyam bahut vistrit tatha vividh the. Exam point: Bihar me vivah samanyatah vadhu ke ghar hota tha tatha rasmein poori hone par dulhan var ke ghar jaati thi, lekin Mithila jaise sthanon me dulhan ko vivah ke usi din var ke ghar le jaaya jaata tha.

qe: Among the purificatory penances of Bihar, which one required a person to swallow a mixture of the five products of the cow?
qh: बिहार के शुद्धिकरण तपों में किसमें व्यक्ति को गाय के पाँच उत्पादों का मिश्रण निगलना पड़ता था?
e: Shudhikaran ke liye jati vyavastha me do tarah ke upay the - tapasya yaani purificatory penances tatha prayashchit ke samaroh yaani ceremonies of expiation. Tapasya ke pramukh roop the: ek nirdharit samay ke liye teerth yatra par jaana, Ganga me snan karna tatha uski baloo nigalna, ek nirdharit samay tak bheekh par jeevan-yapan karna, ek nirdharit samay tak moun rakhna, chaubees ghanton me keval ek bar bhojan karna, gaay ke paanch utpadon ke mishran yaani panchgavya ko nigalna tatha upvas karna. Prayashchit ke samarohon me yaag, Satyanarayan ki puja, parivarik purohit ko gaay, bachhdi yaani heifer tatha anya dan dena tatha Brahmanon tatha jati-bandhuon ko bhojan karana shaamil tha. Exam point: Panchgavya yaani gaay ke paanch utpadon ka mishran nigalna ek pramukh shuddhikaran tapasya thi; anya tapasyayen teerth yatra, Ganga ke baloo khana, ek samay me ek bhojan tatha upvas the.

qe: Besides breaches of caste rules, which kind of cases were also disposed of by the caste panchayats of Bihar?
qh: जाति नियमों के उल्लंघन के अतिरिक्त बिहार की जाति पंचायतें किस प्रकार के मामलों का भी निपटारा करती थीं?
oe: Only cases of breach of contract
Cases of adultery, seduction and elopement
Only cases of theft and robbery
oh: व्यभिचार, प्रलोभन तथा भागकर विवाह जैसे मामले
केवल भूमि की सीमा से जुड़े विवाद
केवल चोरी तथा डकैती के मामले
e: Jati panchayaten keval jati ke niyamon tatha shishtachar yaani etiquette ke ullanghan tak hi simit nahi thin; woh vyabhichar yaani adultery, pralobhan yaani seduction tatha saath chhod kar bhaag jaane yaani elopement jaise maamlon ka bhi nirnay karti thin. Jati ke maamle nipatane me yeh jati-tribunals kai bar civil tatha criminal adalaton ke kshetra me bhi dakhal deti thin. In panchayaton ki sazaen is prakar thin - outcasting yaani jati se nikalna (temporary ya permanent), jurmana, jati-bandhuon ko bhoj, sharirik dand tatha uchh vargon me prayashchit. Gambhir samajik aparadhon - jaise nichli jati ke vyakti se bhojan lena ya nichle varg ki mahila se vivah karke usse chhodne se inkar - par sthayi bahishkar diya jaata tha; vyabhichar tatha varjit peshe apnane par bhi kai bar outcasting hoti thi; chhote aparadhon par jurmana ya bhoj ki saza hoti thi. Exam point: Jati panchayaten vyabhichar, pralobhan tatha elopement jaise maamlon ka bhi nirnay karti thin tatha inki sazaon me outcasting, jurmana, bhoj, sharirik dand tatha prayashchit shaamil the.

qe: In the early nineteenth century, the higher castes of which district were said to have panchayats of their own, presided over by the most learned and wealthy persons of the neighbourhood?
qh: उन्नीसवीं सदी के प्रारंभ में किस जिले की उच्च जातियों की अपनी पंचायतें थीं, जिनकी अध्यक्षता मोहल्ले के सर्वाधिक विद्वान तथा धनवान व्यक्ति करते थे?
e: Rajya jatiyon ke antarik maamlon me dakhal nahi deta tha, isliye jatiyan apne maamle khud chalati thin. Uchh jatiyon me aam taur par koi niyantran sanstha ya constituted authority nahi thi jo shikayaten sunkar faisla de sake. Purnea me unnisvin sadi ke shuruaati samay me uchh jatiyon ki apni panchayaten thin, jinme mohalle ke sabse vidwan tatha dhanvan vyakti adhyakshta karte the; Kshatriya tatha Kayastha ki sabhaon me aam taur par ek Brahman sahayak hota tha. Patna tatha Shahabad me Brahmanon ki sabhaon ko 'samooh' kaha jaata tha. Kayasthas tatha anya uchh jatiyon me koi mukhiya maanyata prapt nahi tha. Nichli jatiyon me aaj bhi jati-nyay ki ek vyavastha hai, jise jati panchayat kehte hain; is adhikar ka aadhaar sadasyon ko jati se bahishkar karne ki shakti hai tatha yeh shakti purohit, naai tatha dhobi ke sahyog par nirbhar karti hai. Exam point: Purnea me uchh jatiyon ki apni panchayaten thin jinme mohalle ke sabse vidwan tatha dhanvan log adhyakshta karte the, tatha Patna tatha Shahabad me Brahmanon ki sabhaon ko 'samooh' kaha jaata tha.

qe: Under the classification of Muslim castes in Bihar, which were the three main groups?
qh: बिहार में मुस्लिम जातियों के वर्गीकरण में कौन-से तीन मुख्य समूह थे?
e: Islam ka siddhant jati-vyavastha ke bahar ka hai, kyunki Islam samanata yaani equality par zor deta hai tatha Vedantic siddhanton ke bhi virudh hai. Lekin Hinduon ke saath lagatar sampark ke karan jaati vyavastha Muslim samaj me bhi kuchh had tak pahunch gayi. Muslim jatiyan bhi jati-antarvivah yaani caste endogamy ka niyam maanti hain tatha unki apni jati panchayaten hoti hain; ek saath khaane-peene yaani commensality ke niyam bhi alag-alag hote hain. Us samay kai jatiyon ko teen mukhya samuhon me vargikrit kiya jaata tha - Ashraf, Ajlaf tatha Arzal. Exam point: Bihar me Muslim castes ko Ashraf, Ajlaf tatha Arzal - in teen mukhya samuhon me vargikrit kiya gaya tha, jinme jati-antarvivah tatha jati panchayat ke niyam Hindu prabhav se aaye the.

qe: In the study of tribal Bihar, the term 'Adivasi' is used in which sense?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार के अध्ययन में 'आदिवासी' शब्द किस अर्थ में प्रयोग होता है?
oe: A general term for all the scheduled tribes of India, meaning the original inhabitants
A term for Muslim converts of tribal origin
A term for the Sudra cultivators of Manbhum
A term for the hill zamindars of Chotanagpur
oh: भारत की सभी अनुसूचित जनजातियों के लिए सामान्य शब्द, जिसका अर्थ मूल निवासी है
जनजातीय मूल के मुस्लिम धर्मांतरितों के लिए शब्द
मानभूम के शूद्र कृषकों के लिए शब्द
छोटानागपुर के पहाड़ी जमींदारों के लिए शब्द
e: Adivasi ka arth hai 'original inhabitant' yaani mool nivaasi. Yeh Bharat ki sabhi scheduled tribes yaani anusoochit janjatiyon ke liye ek samanya shabd hai. Bihar ki janjatiyan saamagri yaani material tatha naitik sanskriti ke alag-alag charan yaani stages me hain tatha unki samajik tatha aarthik sanrachnaen bhi alag-alag hain. Woh na keval gair-janjatiya abadiyon se bahut alag hain, balki ek doosre se bhi alag hain - unke jeevan-nirvah ke sadhanon, dharmik vicharon, samajik sangathan tatha bhasha me antar milta hai. Lekin in lakshanon ke beech koi ek-sa lagatar sambandh yaani consistent correlation sthapit nahi kiya ja sakta. Exam point: Adivasi ka arth 'original inhabitant' yaani mool nivaasi hai tatha yeh Bharat ki sabhi scheduled tribes ke liye samanya shabd hai; Bihar ki janjatiyan jeevan-nirvah, dharm, samajik sangathan tatha bhasha me ek doosre se alag hain.

qe: Which of the following sects in Bihar deny the sanctity of caste and hold that all men can worship God alike?
qh: बिहार के निम्नलिखित संप्रदायों में कौन जाति की पवित्रता को नहीं मानते तथा यह मत रखते हैं कि सभी मनुष्य समान रूप से ईश्वर की उपासना कर सकते हैं?
oe: Only the Santhal and Munda tribes
e: Vaishnava, Kabirpanthi, Nanakshahi tatha Atith (Saivites ki ek shakha) ye chaar sampraday jati ki pavitrata yaani sanctity ko nahi maante. Unka vichar hai ki sabhi manushya ek hi tarah Bhagwan ki upasana kar sakte hain. Isliye koi vyakti jati me kitna hi nichla ho, woh Vaishnava ban sakta hai. Jab koi vyakti in sampradayon me shaamil hona chahta hai to woh kisi math yaani monastery me jaata hai tatha us math ke Mahanth dwara ordain yaani dikshit kiya jaata hai. Is tarah yeh sampraday jati-vyavastha ke kathor niyamon se alag ek rasta pradan karte the tatha nichli jatiyon ke logon ko samajik samman dene ka rasta kholte the. Exam point: Vaishnava, Kabirpanthi, Nanakshahi tatha Atith sampraday jati ki pavitrata ko nahi maante tatha sabhi manushyon ki saman upasana ko manyata dete hain; inme shaamil hone ke liye math ke Mahanth dwara diksha milti hai.

qe: Of the 88,000 Kharias of Bihar, 78,000 live in the Ranchi district and are known by which two names?
qh: बिहार के 88,000 खड़िया में से 78,000 राँची जिले में रहते हैं तथा किन दो नामों से जाने जाते हैं?
e: Kharia janjati ke udaharan se pata chalta hai ki ek hi janjati ke andar bhi bhoogol tatha sthaniya paryavaran ke karan aarthik sthiti me antar paida ho jaata hai. 88,000 Khariyaon me se 78,000 Ranchi zile me rehte hain tatha Dudh tatha Dhelki Kharia ke roop me jaane jaate hain. Baaki log Hill Kharia kehlate hain tatha Manbhum tatha Dhalbhum ki unchaai wali dhalanon par rehte hain, jahan woh shifting cultivation yaani sthanantarit kheti karte hain tatha apne hi janjatiya bandhuon tatha anya logon se alag rehte hain. Dudh tatha Dhelki Kharia anya janjatiya tatha Hindu logon ke nazdeek nichli bhoomi par bhi rehte hain tatha unhe sthayi hal-kheti ki aadat hai; isliye aarthik roop se woh Munda, Oraon tatha anya padosi janjatiyon ke saath bahut kuchh sajha karte hain. Exam point: 88,000 Khariyaon me se 78,000 Ranchi zile ke Dudh tatha Dhelki Kharia hain, jabki baaki Hill Kharia Manbhum tatha Dhalbhum ki dhalanon par rehkar shifting cultivation karte hain.

qe: Which one profession did Colebrooke find reserved to the Brahmanas of Bihar?
qh: कॉलब्रुक ने बिहार में ब्राह्मणों के लिए आरक्षित कौन-सा एक व्यवसाय पाया?
oe: Teaching the Vedas and officiating at religious ceremonies
oh: चमड़े का काम तथा जूते बनाना
वेद पढ़ाना तथा धार्मिक अनुष्ठानों में पुरोहिताई करना
e: Jati vyavastha peshe ke mamle me kadi nahi thi; koi vyakti apne pita ke peshe tak hi simit nahi tha. Colebrooke ne paaya ki keval ek hi pesha Brahmanon ke liye aarakshit yaani reserved tha - Ved padhana tatha dharmik samarohon me purohit ka kaam karna. Lekin ve is baat ko nahi dekh paaye ki Brahman bhi is tak simit nahi the; woh bhi anya peshe karte the tatha kai anya jatiyan bhi purohit ka kaam karti thin. Yeh bhi dekha gaya ki log apne paramparik jatiya kartavyon par kadi tarah nahi chalte the; guzara karne ke liye kai log aise peshe apnaate the jinse unki jati ko rok thi. Exam point: Colebrooke ne paaya ki keval Brahmanon ka ek pesha - Ved padhana tatha dharmik samarohon me purohitai karna - hi aarakshit tha, lekin vyavahar me Brahman tatha anya jatiyan is niyam ka kadi palan nahi karti thin.

qe: Which of the following tribal groups of Bihar still derive most of their subsistence from storing and selling forest produce?
qh: बिहार के निम्नलिखित जनजातीय समूहों में कौन अभी भी अपनी अधिकांश जीविका वन-उपज को संग्रह करके बेचने से प्राप्त करते हैं?
oe: The Birhors, some Hill Kharias, the Bijias of Palamau and a few Saoria Paharias
oh: बिरहोर, कुछ पहाड़ी खड़िया, पलामू के बिजिया तथा कुछ सौरिया पहाड़िया
e: Bihar ki bahut kam janjatiyan abhi bhi shikar tatha khady-sangrah ke charan me hain, lekin unki sankhya bahut kam hai. Birhor janjati ka Dihlu hissa, kuchh Hill Kharia, Palamau ke Bijia tatha kuchh Saoria Paharia aaj bhi apni adhiktar guzarisht jungle ki upaj yaani forest produce ko jama karke tatha bech kar karte hain; iska ek hissa woh khud khapat yaani consume karte hain. Inme se kuchh log kabhi-kabhi 'slash and burn' yaani jala-bojh vidhi se shifting cultivation se faslen bhi ugaate hain. Shesh adhiktar janjatiyaen sthayi kheton me kheti karti hain tatha unme se kuchh saghai yaani terracing tatha sinchai ki vidhi bhi jaanti hain. Exam point: Birhor janjati ka Dihlu hissa, kuchh Hill Kharia, Palamau ke Bijia tatha kuchh Saoria Paharia abhi bhi paramukhya roop se jungle ki upaj jama karke tatha bech kar guzara karte hain.

qe: Which of the following illustrates the social mobility permitted in the caste order of Bihar?
qh: बिहार की जाति व्यवस्था में जो सामाजिक गतिशीलता संभव थी, उसका उदाहरण कौन-सा है?
oe: A wealthy Mehtar being unable to employ a Brahmana as his cook
Sudras being zamindars and Rajas and presiding over Dharmasabhas where Brahmanas were ordinary members
A Chamar being debarred from service in the police and the army
A Brahmana refusing under all circumstances to serve a low-caste Raja
oh: धनी मेहतर का ब्राह्मण को रसोइया नियुक्त न कर पाना
शूद्रों का जमींदार तथा राजा होना तथा ऐसी धर्मसभाओं की अध्यक्षता करना जिनमें ब्राह्मण साधारण सदस्य थे
चमार का पुलिस तथा सेना की सेवा से वंचित होना
ब्राह्मण का हर हाल में निम्न जाति के राजा की सेवा से इनकार
e: Jati vyavastha me niche se upar tak koi kadi rukavat nahi thi; dhan-sampatti ke bal par parivartan tatha gatishilta sambhav thi. Ek sadharan dukandar dhanvan vyapari ban sakta tha tatha ek dhanvan vyapari sevak ki halat tak gir sakta tha. Mehtar ya Chamar bhi apne janm se mile nichle kaamon se santusht na reh kar police tatha sena me uncha pad pa sakta tha. Kai Sudra zamindar the tatha kuchh Raja bhi, jo Dharmasabhaon ki adhyakshta karte the tatha un sabhaon me Brahman sadharan sadasya hote the; Sudraon ko hamesha Brahmanon ki seva ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta tha. Nichli jati ke Raja bhi Brahmanon ko apni seva me lene me koi aafat mahsoos nahi karte the; agar koi Chamar ya safai-karmchari avashyak dhan kama leta to use koi mushkil nahi hoti ki woh Brahmanon ko rasoiya ya anya nichla kaam ke liye apne yahan rakhe. Yeh bhi bataya jaata hai ki jati-bahishkrit logon ko Sanskrit seekhne se roka nahi jaata tha tatha Brahman khud kabhi-kabhi bachhde ke chamde se jili kitaben istemal karte the. Exam point: Jati vyavastha me gatishilta thi - Sudra zamindar tatha Raja ban sakte the tatha Brahmanon wali dharma sabhaon ki adhyakshta kar sakte the, tatha nichle varg ke log police tatha sena me uncha pad pa sakte the.

qe: Which of the following statements about the occupations of the tribes of Bihar is correct?
qh: बिहार की जनजातियों के व्यवसायों के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
oe: All tribesmen are still confined to hunting for their livelihood
Tribesmen work only as village priests and school teachers
Many tribesmen work in the mines and factories of their own area, and in the tea gardens of Assam and the jute mills of Bengal
Tribesmen are forbidden by custom from working in mines and factories
oh: सभी जनजातीय लोग अब भी जीविका के लिए केवल शिकार तक सीमित हैं
जनजातीय लोग केवल गाँव के पुजारी तथा स्कूल शिक्षक का काम करते हैं
बहुत से जनजातीय लोग अपने ही क्षेत्र की खानों तथा कारखानों में तथा असम के चाय-बागानों और बंगाल की जूट मिलों में काम करते हैं
जनजातीय लोगों को रीति से खानों तथा कारखानों में काम करने की मनाही है
e: Bihar ki adhiktar janjatiyaen sthayi kheton me kheti karti hain tatha unme se kuchh saghai yaani terracing tatha sinchai ki vidhiyan bhi jaanti hain. Iske saath hi bahut si janjatiyaen apne hi kshetra me khanyon yaani mines tatha karakhano yaani factories me kaam karti hain, jabki bahut se log Assam ke chai ke baaghaan yaani tea gardens tatha Bengal ki jute mills me kaam karne jaate hain. Is tarah adivasi jeevan keval paramparik kheti tak simit nahi hai; aadhunik aarthik sanrachnaon me unki bhaagidari lagatar badhi hai. In badlavon ke karan unki samajik tatha aarthik sthitiyan bhi badal rahi hain tatha material tatha moral culture ke alag-alag charan bane hain. Exam point: Bihar ki janjatiyaen apne kshetra ki khanyon tatha karakhano me tatha Assam ke chai-baaghaan aur Bengal ki jute mills me kaam karti hain, isliye unka jeevan keval paramparik kheti tak simit nahi hai.

qe: Which of the following modifications in caste restrictions has been noticed in modern Bihar?
qh: आधुनिक बिहार में जाति-प्रतिबंधों में कौन-सा परिवर्तन देखा गया है?
oe: Losing caste on being touched by an untouchable became more frequent
Travel by bus and rail made the observance of caste distances easier
Inter-dining in towns became common and sub-caste marriages became everyday affairs, though inter-caste marriage remained rare
Inter-caste marriage became very common in the villages
oh: अस्पृश्य के स्पर्श से जाति खोने की घटनाएँ और बढ़ गईं
बस तथा रेल से यात्रा ने जातिगत दूरियाँ बनाए रखना आसान बना दिया
कस्बों में सहभोज सामान्य हो गया तथा उपजातिगत विवाह रोजमर्रा की बात बन गए, यद्यपि अंतर्जातीय विवाह विरल ही रहा
गाँवों में अंतर्जातीय विवाह बहुत सामान्य हो गया
e: Modern samay me jati-bandhano me kaafi badlav aaya. Bihar ke kasbon yaani shahron me kai jatiyon ke beech inter-dining yaani ek saath khaana-peena aam ho gaya; bus tatha rail se yatra badhne ke karan jatiyon ke beech doori banaye rakhna mushkil ho gaya; chhoot ke sparsh se jati khone ki pratha ab ateet ki baat ban gayi; up-jati ke andar vivah aam baat ho gayi, lekin inter-caste yaani antajatiya vivah abhi bhi kam hi hai. Iske saath hi uchh jatiyon me ab jati panchayat nahi rahi, kyunki sadasya door-door bikhar gaye hain tatha saza se bachne ke raste maujud hain; isliye bahishkar ab pehle jaisa bhay nahi raha. Lekin Sudron me jati panchayaten aaj bhi shaktishali hain. Exam point: Modern Bihar me shahron me inter-dining tatha up-jati-vivah aam ho gaye, chhoot ke sparsh par jati khone ki pratha ateet ban gayi tatha uchh jatiyon me jati panchayat ka bhay khatm hua, lekin Sudron me jati panchayaten abhi bhi shaktishali hain.

qe: Besides a majority of tribal people, the typical tribal village of Bihar also contains families of which functional castes?
qh: बिहार के विशिष्ट जनजातीय गाँव में जनजातीय लोगों के बहुमत के अतिरिक्त किन कार्यात्मक जातियों के परिवार भी रहते हैं?
oe: Lohars, Ghasis, Mahlis, Jolahas and Ahirs
oh: लोहार, घासी, महली, जोलाहा तथा अहीर
e: Janjatiya gaon ki abadi aam taur par adhiktar janjatiya logon ki hoti hai, lekin lagbhag har gaon me kuch karyatmak yaani functional jatiyon ke bhi parivar rehte hain - jaise Lohar, Ghasi, Mahli, Jolaha tatha Ahir aadi. Janjatiya gaon me logon ki samajik tatha aarthik sthiti me aam taur par koi bada antar nahi hota. Mundas me abhi bhi mool nivaasiyon yaani original settlers ke vanshajon tatha baad me aane wale logon ke vanshajon me kuchh antar hota hai, lekin isse gaon ki loktantrik yaani democratic vyavastha par koi asar nahi padta tatha gaon samuday ke andar sabhi log bhaichare ki bhavna se jude rehte hain. Exam point: Janjatiya gaon me adhiktar janjatiya logon ke saath Lohar, Ghasi, Mahli, Jolaha tatha Ahir jaise karyatmak jatiyon ke parivar bhi rehte hain tatha Mundas me mool nivaasiyon tatha baad me aane wale vanshajon ka antar loktantrik vyavastha ko kamzor nahi karta.

qe: In which district was the occupation of a groom (horse-keeper) considered degrading by the Dusadhs and therefore involved expulsion from the caste?
qh: किस जिले में घोड़ों की देखरेख का पेशा दुसाधों द्वारा अपमानजनक माना जाता था तथा इस कारण जाति से बहिष्कार हो जाता था?
e: Dusadh jati Patna zile ke sath-sath Bihar ke anya hisson me bhi milti hai tatha woh kai upjatiyon me banti hai. Inke bahut kam logon ke paas apni zameen hoti hai. Dusadhon ke bahut se log ghode ki dekh-rekh karne wale yaani groom ka kaam karte the, lekin Bhagalpur zile me is peshe ko apmaanjanak yaani degrading maana jaata tha tatha isse jati se bahishkar yaani expulsion ho jaata tha. Isi tarah unme se kuchh ghaas katne wale, lakdi katne wale tatha bharuya yaani porters ka kaam bhi karte the. Isse pata chalta hai ki jati vyavastha me kisi peshe ka samajik mulya sthaniya manyataon ke hisaab se badalta tha tatha ek hi pesha alag-alag sthanon par alag tarah se dekha jaata tha. Exam point: Bhagalpur me Dusadhon me ghode ki dekh-rekh yaani groom ka pesha apmaanjanak maana jaata tha tatha isse jati se bahishkar ho jaata tha.

qe: The typical village of which tribe is situated on high ground on a ridge surrounded by undulating country?
qh: किस जनजाति का विशिष्ट गाँव ऊँची भूमि पर एक कटक (रिज) पर स्थित होता है, जिसे चारों ओर ऊबड़-खाबड़ भूमि घेरती है?
e: Bihar ke janjatiya gaon apne nirman-sthal tatha bhoomishthan ke aadhaar par alag-alag pehchane jaate hain. Sabse typical 'Ho' gaon unchaai wali bhoomi yaani high ground par, ek ridge par hota hai, jise charon or utar-chadhav wala undulating ilaka ghair leta hai. Lekin aaj kal ke nayi base gaon aam taur par nadiyon ya jharhon yaani streams ke kinare ya kabhi-kabhi nadi ki unchi teri par bante hain. Munda tatha Oraon gaon ke liye aas-paas ki sabse unchi samtal bhoomi chuni jaati hai. Dudh tatha Dhelki janjatiyon ke gaon aam taur par kisi nadi ya jharhe ke kinare bante hain tatha adhiktar yeh gaon sthayi hote hain, jinme char se sau tak jhopdiyan hoti hain. Exam point: Ho janjati ka typical gaon unchaai wali ridge par sthit hota hai, jabki Munda tatha Oraon aas-paas ki sabse unchi samtal bhoomi chunte hain tatha Dudh-Dhelki gaon nadi-jharhon ke kinare bante hain.

qe: Besides making shoes out of leather, which role was performed by the women of the Chamar caste?
qh: चमड़े से जूते बनाने के अतिरिक्त चमार जाति की महिलाएँ कौन-सी भूमिका निभाती थीं?
oe: They served as village priests in temples
They worked as goldsmiths and jewellers
They were employed as scribes and accountants
They acted as midwives and also played music at weddings and other domestic festivals
oh: वे मंदिरों में गाँव की पुजारिन का काम करती थीं
वे सुनार तथा जौहरी का काम करती थीं
वे लेखक तथा मुनीम का काम करती थीं
वे दाई का काम करती थीं तथा विवाह और अन्य घरेलू त्योहारों पर संगीत बजाती थीं
e: Chamar jati untouchables me sabse pramukh maani jaati thi. Log chamde ka kaam karte the tatha joote banate the. Unme se kuchh kheti karte the, mukhya roop se din-mazdoor yaani day labourers ke roop me. Unki mahilaen dai yaani midwives ka kaam karti thin tatha vivah tatha anya gharelu tyoharon par saaz bajane ka kaam bhi karti thin. Kuchh Chamar kisan tatha bhoomiheen mazdoor bhi the. Unki sthiti dikhati hai ki untouchable jatiyan mukhya roop se gandhe ya apmaanjanak maane jaane wale peshon se judi thin, lekin unke andar bhi mukhya peshon ke aadhaar par alag-alag upjatiyan bani hui thin. Exam point: Chamar mahilaen dai yaani midwife ka kaam karti thin tatha vivah aadi avsaron par saaz bajati thin; Chamar purush mukhya roop se chamde ka kaam tatha joote banane ka pesha karte the.

qe: The houses of which tribe are built on both sides of a long straggling street known as the 'Sadarkuli'?
qh: किस जनजाति के घर 'सदरकुली' नामक एक लंबी फैली हुई गली के दोनों ओर बनाए जाते हैं?
e: Janjatiya gaon ke layout yaani naksha kisi ek samanya niyam ka palan nahi karte, lekin Santhal iska apvaad hain: woh apne ghar ek lambi-si bikhri hui gali yaani long straggling street ke dono kinaron par banate hain, jise 'Sadarkuli' kaha jaata hai, tatha unke ghar bina kisi yojna ke guthne hue yaani huddled rehte hain. Baaki janjatiyon ke gaon-sthal ki chunav tatha ghar ke prakar unki avashyaktaon tatha unke samanya sanskritik star ko darshate hain. Lagbhag har ghar ke saath ek chhota sabzi-baag juda hota hai jahan sabziyan ugai jaati thin; maveshi tatha murgiyon ko rakhne ke liye sthan tatha ghar ke aas-paas suar bandhne ke liye bhi jagah hoti thi. Exam point: Santhal janjati ke ghar 'Sadarkuli' naam ki ek lambi bikhri hui gali ke dono kinaron par bina kisi yojna ke guthne hue banaye jaate hain tatha har ghar ke saath sabzi-baag juda hota hai.

qe: Which of the following occupations were commonly followed by the Doms of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के डोम सामान्यतः कौन-कौन से व्यवसाय करते थे?
oe: Weaving silk and trading in grain
Sweeping, scavenging and working in bamboo, straw and cane
oh: रेशम बुनाई तथा अनाज का व्यापार
सफाई, भंगी का काम तथा बाँस, भूसा और बेंत का काम
e: Dom aam taur par safai-karmchari tatha bhangi yaani sweeper tatha scavenger ka kaam karte the. Woh baans, bhoosa tatha bet yaani bamboo, straw and cane ka kaam bhi karte the. Unme se kai log public executioner yaani maut ki saza dene wale the tatha mare hue jaanwaron ke shareer hataane wale the. Kuchh Dom kisan tatha daali-don banane wale the, jabki anya saaz bajane wale. Alag-alag peshe baant kar unki upjatiyan ban gayi thin. Magahia Dom bahut nichla darja rakhte the, kyunki woh mare hue jaanwaron ka maans tatha doosron ka chhoda hua bhojan khate the. Kuchh sthanon par unhe shmashan ki chita jalane ke liye lakdi, bhoosa tatha aag pahunchane ka anya adhikar bhi tha. Exam point: Dom aam taur par safai tatha bhangi ka kaam, baans-bhoosa-bet ke kaam tatha kuchh log public executioner ka kaam karte the; Magahia Dom carcase khane ke karan bahut nichla darja rakhte the.

qe: In a Munda house, what does the 'Ading' contain?
qh: मुंडा के घर में 'अदिंग' में क्या होता है?
oe: The cattle shed for oxen and buffaloes
The sleeping place of the village boys
The sacred place where the ancestral spirits of the family reside
The granary for storing paddy and millets
oh: गाँव के लड़कों के सोने का स्थान
वह पवित्र स्थान जहाँ परिवार के पूर्वजों की आत्माएँ निवास करती हैं
धान तथा मोटे अनाज रखने का कोठार
e: Munda ghar ke andar ek 'Ading' hota hai - yahi pavitr sthan hai jahan parivar ke purvajon yaani ancestors ki aatmaen rehti hain. Ghar aam taur par mitti ke bane hote hain tatha unki chhat pakki tilyon yaani baked tiles se hoti hai. Har ghar ke saath ek chhota sabzi-baag juda hota hai jahan sabziyan ugai jaati thin; maveshi tatha murgiyon ko rakhne ke liye sthan tatha ghar ke aas-paas suar bandhne ke liye bhi jagah hoti thi. Ghar ka prakar janjati ki avashyaktaon tatha unke samanya sanskritik star ko darshata hai. Exam point: Munda ghar ke andar 'Ading' wahi pavitr sthan hota hai jahan parivar ke purvajon ki aatmaen rehti hain tatha har ghar ke saath sabzi-baag tatha maveshi rakhne ki jagah judi hoti hai.

qe: In Mithila, how did the Dom women welcome a newcomer?
qh: मिथिला में डोम महिलाएँ नए आने वाले व्यक्ति का स्वागत किस प्रकार करती थीं?
oe: By washing his feet with milk in silver vessels
By sprinkling rice and turmeric at the village gate
By singing songs while carrying water-pots containing mango leaves on their heads
By offering him a garland of gold coins
oh: चाँदी के पात्रों में दूध से उनके चरण धोकर
गाँव के द्वार पर चावल तथा हल्दी छिड़ककर
सिर पर आम के पत्तों से युक्त जल-कलश लेकर गीत गाकर
सोने के सिक्कों की माला पहनाकर
e: Dom jati Bihar ki untouchable jatiyon me aati hai, lekin uski apni kuchh vishesh samajik bhoomikayen tatha paramparaen thin. Mithila me Dom mahilaen naye aane wale vyakti ka swagat geet gaa kar karti thin tatha apne sar par aam ke patton se yukta jal ke kalash yaani water-pots dharan karti thin. Kuchh sthanon par Dom jati ko shmashan ki chita ke liye lakdi, bhoosa tatha aag pahunchane ka akela adhikar tha. In riwazon se dikhata hai ki jati vyavastha me sabse nichle darje ki jatiyan bhi apni paramparaon tatha karya-bhaag ke liye pehchani jaati thin tatha unka apna alag samajik tatha sanskritik sthan tha. Exam point: Mithila me Dom mahilaen sar par aam ke patton wale jal-kalash lekar geet gaakar naye aane wale vyakti ka swagat karti thin tatha kuchh sthanon par unhe shmashan ke liye lakdi, bhoosa tatha aag pahunchane ka anya adhikar tha.

qe: What is the 'Akhara' in a tribal village of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के किसी जनजातीय गाँव में 'अखारा' क्या होता है?
oe: A dancing ground where the inhabitants gather for regular dancing in the evening and during festivals
A sacred grove where the village deities are believed to reside
A bone burial ground situated outside the village
A dormitory for unmarried boys of the village
oh: नृत्य-स्थल, जहाँ निवासी सायंकाल तथा त्योहारों के समय नियमित नृत्य के लिए एकत्र होते हैं
पवित्र उपवन, जहाँ गाँव के देवता निवास करते माने जाते हैं
गाँव के बाहर स्थित अस्थि-निक्षेप स्थल
गाँव के अविवाहित लड़कों का छात्रावास
e: Adhiktar janjatiya gaonon me ek 'Akhara' yaani nritya-sthal hota hai, jahan gaon ke nivasi shaam ko niyamit roop se tatha tyoharon ke samay nritya ke liye ikattha hote hain. Isi tarah Munda tatha Kharia gaonon me gaon ke bahar ek 'Sasan' naamak asthi-nikshep sthal yaani bone burial ground milta hai, jahan mool nivaasiyon ke vanshajon ke avshesh varshik samaroh ke baad dafnaye jaate hain. Adhiktar gaonon me ek 'Sarna' naamak pavitr upvan bhi hota hai, jahan gaon ke devta nivas karte maane jaate hain tatha jahan gaon ka purohit yaani Pahan puja arpan karta hai. Yeh tino sthal janjatiya samajik tatha dharmik jeevan ke mahatvapurn kendra the. Exam point: Akhara janjatiya gaon ka nritya-sthal hai jahan shaam tatha tyoharon par log nritya ke liye ikattha hote hain, jabki Sasan asthi-nikshep-sthal tatha Sarna gaon ke devtaon ka pavitr upvan hota hai.

qe: In the tribal villages of Bihar, what was the 'Sarna', and who offered worship there?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय गाँवों में 'सरना' क्या था तथा वहाँ पूजा कौन अर्पित करता था?
oe: A market place held on a fixed day of the week, presided over by the headman
A burial ground where the bones of the original settlers were kept
A council hall where the caste panchayat met
A sacred grove where the village deities were supposed to reside, worship being offered by the village priest or Pahan
oh: सप्ताह के निश्चित दिन लगने वाला बाजार, जिसकी अध्यक्षता गाँव का मुखिया करता था
वह कब्रिस्तान जहाँ मूल निवासियों की अस्थियाँ रखी जाती थीं
वह सभा-भवन जहाँ जाति पंचायत बैठती थी
पवित्र उपवन, जहाँ गाँव के देवता निवास करते माने जाते थे तथा जहाँ गाँव का पुजारी या पाहन पूजा अर्पित करता था
e: Adhiktar janjatiya gaonon me ek 'Sarna' naamak pavitr upvan yaani sacred grove hota hai, jahan gaon ke devta nivas karte maane jaate hain tatha jahan gaon ka purohit yaani Pahan puja arpan karta hai. Isi tarah gaon ke bahar ek 'Sasan' naamak asthi-nikshep sthal hota hai, jahan mool nivaasiyon ke vanshajon ke avshesh varshik samaroh ke baad dafnaye jaate hain, tatha gaon me ek 'Akhara' yaani nritya-sthal bhi hota hai jahan log shaam tatha tyoharon par nritya ke liye ikattha hote hain. Yeh sthal dikhate hain ki janjatiya dharm prakriti tatha poorvaj-puja se juda tha tatha uske kendriya sthal gaon ke bheetar tatha bahar dono jagah maujud the. Exam point: Sarna gaon ke devtaon ka pavitr upvan tha, jahan gaon ka purohit yaani Pahan puja arpan karta tha; Sasan asthi-nikshep sthal tatha Akhara nritya-sthal ke roop me jaane jaate the.

qe: The 'Dhumkuria' of the Oraons west of Ranchi was which type of institution?
qh: राँची के पश्चिम में उराँव जनजाति का 'धुमकुरिया' किस प्रकार की संस्था था?
oe: A market for the sale of tribal produce
A youth dormitory and school of social discipline and training for boys
A granary maintained by the village headman
A court of the caste panchayat
oh: जनजातीय उपज की बिक्री का बाजार
लड़कों के लिए युवा-छात्रावास तथा सामाजिक अनुशासन और प्रशिक्षण का विद्यालय
गाँव के मुखिया द्वारा रखा जाने वाला कोठार
e: Ranchi ke paschim ki Oraon gaonon me ek mahatvapurn sanstha 'Dhumkuria' yaani yuva-chhatravas yaani youth dormitory hoti hai. Yeh samajik anushasan tatha prashikshan ka ek vidyalaya hai, jahan yuva keval gyaan hi nahi paate balki woh sabhi gun bhi apnaate hain jo unhe samuday ka ek upyogi sadasya banate hain. Ladke ko lagbhag gyarah ya barah saal ki umar me Dhumkuria bheja jaata hai tatha woh vivah tak wahan rehta hai. Dhumkuria ke ladke ek samuhik nikaya yaani corporate body ki tarah kaam karte hain, jiske monitor ko 'Mahto' kaha jaata hai, tatha woh vivah ya anya bhojon ki taiyariyon me madad karte hain. Oraon ke paas ladkiyon ke liye alag tatha niji chhatravas bhi hote hain; dono chhatravason me sahyog tatha parasparikta hoti hai, jinka sabse mahatvapurn karya yuva purushon tatha mahilaon ko gaana tatha nritya sikhana hai. Exam point: Dhumkuria Oraon gaonon ka youth dormitory tha - samajik anushasan tatha prashikshan ka vidyalaya, jahan ladke gyarah-barah saal ki umar se vivah tak rehte the tatha jinke monitor ko 'Mahto' kaha jaata tha; Oraon ke paas ladkiyon ke alag chhatravas bhi the.

qe: Among the Mundas, what was the 'Ghora'?
oe: The sacred grove of the clan deity
A sleeping house fulfilling no other function than being a secluded resting place
A dance ground used during festivals
oh: सोने का घर, जो एकांत विश्राम-स्थल के अतिरिक्त कोई अन्य कार्य नहीं करता था
त्योहारों के समय प्रयोग होने वाला नृत्य-स्थल
e: Mundas me yahan-wahan gaon ke yuvaon ko kisi suni-jaani ghar ya kisi ke baramde me sote hue dekha ja sakta hai; aise sone ke gharon ko 'Ghora' kaha jaata tha, lekin yeh keval ekant yaani seclusion me aaram karne ke sthal the tatha koi anya samajik karya nahi karte the. Iske vipreet Oraon gaonon ka Dhumkuria keval sone ka sthan nahi tha balki samajik anushasan tatha prashikshan ka kendra tha, jahan yuva ko sex ke rahasyon me dikshit kiya jaata tha, parishram ki garima sikhayi jaati thi tatha chhoti-chhoti zimmedariyan uthana sikhaya jaata tha; unme se kuchh ko netritva tatha sangathan ka prashikshan bhi milta tha. Is tulna se pata chalta hai ki ek jaisi dikhne wali sansthaon ka samajik karya alag-alag janjatiyon me alag ho sakta hai. Exam point: Mundas ka 'Ghora' keval ekant me aaram karne ka sleeping house tha tatha usse koi anya samajik karya nahi hota tha, jabki Oraon ka Dhumkuria ek prashikshan-kendra tha.

qe: Which is the most important crop of tribal Bihar, grown on low-lying irrigated fields?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण फसल कौन-सी है, जो निचली सिंचित भूमि पर उगाई जाती है?
e: Janjatiya gaon ki aarthik zindagi ki do mukhya visheshtaen hain - saralata yaani simplicity tatha aatm-nirbharta yaani self-sufficiency. Kuchh door-sth jungle ilakon ke gaon aavagaman ke abhav ke karan bahari duniya se bahut kam aarthik sambandh rakhte hain, lekin adhiktar gaon anya janjatiya tatha gair-janjatiya gaonon ke saath kuchh aarthik rishte banaye rakhte hain. Janjatiya aarthik vyavastha mukhya roop se guzara-nirvah tatha kheti par adharit hai. Unchi bhoomi par ugai jaane wali mukhya faslen millet yaani mota anaj, kai prakar ki dalein yaani pulses tatha kam darje ke chawal hoti hain. Lekin janjatiya Bihar ki sabse mahatvapurn fasal paddy yaani dhan hai, jo nichli sinchit kheton me ugai jaati hai; sabzi-baag me makai yaani maize tatha sabziyan ugai jaati hain. Exam point: Janjatiya Bihar ki sabse mahatvapurn fasal paddy yaani dhan hai, jo nichli sinchit kheton me hoti hai; unchi bhoomi par millets, pulses tatha kam darje ke chawal ugaye jaate hain.

qe: In the tribal economy of Bihar, what role did the 'hat' play, and who generally did the trading there?
qh: बिहार की जनजातीय अर्थव्यवस्था में 'हाट' की क्या भूमिका थी तथा वहाँ व्यापार सामान्यतः कौन करता था?
oe: It was a village assembly of elders, attended only by men
It was a ceremonial hunt held once a year
It was a grain store managed by the village headman
It was a periodic market held on specified days of the week, and the trading was generally done by women
oh: यह गाँव के बुजुर्गों की सभा थी, जिसमें केवल पुरुष सम्मिलित होते थे
यह वर्ष में एक बार होने वाला औपचारिक शिकार था
यह गाँव के मुखिया द्वारा संचालित अनाज का भंडार था
यह सप्ताह के निर्धारित दिनों पर लगने वाला आवधिक बाजार था तथा वहाँ व्यापार सामान्यतः महिलाएँ करती थीं
e: Janjatiya aarthik vyavastha me paise ki bhoomika seemit thi; len-den bade ho sakte the, lekin haath badalne wali naqad rashi kam hoti thi. Is vyavastha me 'hat' ka ek mahatvapurn sthan tha. Har kshetra me hafte ke nirdharit dino par lagne wale kai bazaar yaani markets hote the tatha vyapar aam taur par mahilaon dwara kiya jaata tha. Yeh bazaar keval aarthik sthal nahi the; woh samajik milan ke sthal bhi the tatha bahut se log manoranjan ke liye bhi wahan jaate the. Is tarah hat janjatiya jeevan me aarthik tatha samajik dono tarah ke karya karne wali ek mahatvapurn sanstha thi. Exam point: 'Hat' hafte ke nirdharit dino par lagne wala bazaar tha, jahan vyapar aam taur par mahilaon dwara kiya jaata tha tatha jo samajik milan ka sthal bhi tha.

qe: What were the 'Khuntkatti' villages of Chotanagpur?
qh: छोटानागपुर के 'खूँटकट्टी' गाँव क्या थे?
oe: Villages held by the Government for tea cultivation
Villages cleared for settlement by the tribes themselves, whose original settlers were long the joint owners
Villages granted to Brahmanas as rent-free land
Villages settled by Muslim weavers in the Mughal period
oh: चाय की खेती के लिए सरकार के अधीन गाँव
जनजातियों द्वारा स्वयं बसाए गए गाँव, जिनके मूल निवासी लंबे समय तक साझे स्वामी रहे
ब्राह्मणों को कर-मुक्त भूमि के रूप में दिए गए गाँव
मुगल काल में मुस्लिम जुलाहों द्वारा बसाए गए गाँव
e: Chotanagpur ke adhiktar gaon janjatiyon dwara khud basane tatha tayyar kiye gaye the tatha ek gaon ke mool nivaasiyon yaani original settlers ke vanshaj lambe samay tak uske saanjhe yaani joint maalik maane jaate the. Aise settlements ko 'Khuntkatti' gaon kaha jaata tha. Aadhunik prabhav ke karan Khuntkatti kaarobari yaani tenure bahut had tak toot gayi hai tatha zameen ab vyaktigat roop se kirayedaron ki hai, jo sarkar ko lagaan dene ke liye zimmedar hain. Saanjhe maalik ke keval do avshesh bache hain - gaon ka pramukh yaani headman, jise alag-alag janjatiyon me alag naam se bulaya jaata tha, tatha gaon ka purohit, jise aaj bhi Khuntkatti-jaanon dwara di gayi zameen ka labh milta hai. Iske bawajood, poori tarah bhoomiheen janjatiya parivar bahut kam hain. Exam point: Khuntkatti gaon Chotanagpur ke woh gaon the jinko janjatiyon ne khud basaya tatha jinke mool nivaasiyon ke vanshaj lambe samay tak saanjhe maalik the; aadhunik prabhav se yeh tenure bahut had tak toot gayi.

qe: Which is the main food of the tribal people of Bihar, and what is eaten during the lean months?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों का मुख्य भोजन क्या है तथा अकाल-जैसे कमी के महीनों में क्या खाया जाता है?
oe: Maize is the main food, and during the lean months fish is eaten
Milk and milk products are the main food throughout the year
Boiled rice is the main food, and during the lean months gondli, millet and mahua are eaten
Wheat bread is the main food, and during the lean months only milk is taken
oh: मक्का मुख्य भोजन है तथा कमी के महीनों में मछली खाई जाती है
दूध तथा दुग्ध-पदार्थ ही साल भर मुख्य भोजन हैं
उबला हुआ चावल मुख्य भोजन है तथा कमी के महीनों में गोंदली, मोटे अनाज तथा महुआ खाया जाता है
गेहूँ की रोटी मुख्य भोजन है तथा कमी के महीनों में केवल दूध लिया जाता है
e: Janjatiya logon ka mukhya bhojan ubla hua chawal yaani boiled rice hai. Adhiktar logon ke liye November se April tak ke mahine bharpur yaani plenty ke hote hain, jabki saal ka shesh samay kam-khaane ka daur yaani lean period hota hai, jisme gondli, millet tatha mahua khaye jaate hain. Kabhi-kabhi shakarkandi yaani sweet potato mukhya bhojan ban jaata hai. Ghar me ugne wali kai prakar ki dalein bhi bhojan me shaamil hoti hain, jaise saag, kaddu, baingan tatha pyaaz. Kai prakar ke berries yaani jangli ber tatha kathal bhi bhojan ko poora karte hain. Doodh ka istemal keval bachhdon yaani calves ko khilane ke liye hota hai. Murga, bhed, bakri tatha kuchh kshetron me suar niyamit roop se khaye jaate hain. Exam point: Ubla hua chawal janjatiya logon ka mukhya bhojan hai; November se April bharpur ke mahine hote hain tatha lean period me gondli, millet tatha mahua khaye jaate hain, jabki doodh keval bachhdon ko pilane me lagta hai.

qe: Each tribe of Bihar, except the Paharias, is divided into which kind of clans?
qh: बिहार की प्रत्येक जनजाति, पहाड़िया के अतिरिक्त, किस प्रकार के कुलों में विभाजित है?
oe: Endogamous clans which must marry within the same clan
Clans based on the occupation of their members
Clans created by the Government for revenue purposes
Exogamous totemic clans whose members are supposed to be descended from a common ancestor
oh: अंतर्विवाही कुल, जिन्हें उसी कुल में विवाह करना पड़ता है
सदस्यों के व्यवसाय पर आधारित कुल
राजस्व उद्देश्यों के लिए सरकार द्वारा बनाए गए कुल
बहिर्विवाही टोटम-कुल, जिनके सदस्य एक सामान्य पूर्वज से उत्पन्न माने जाते हैं
e: Bihar ki pratyek janjati, keval Paharia janjati ke atirikt, kai bahirvivahi yaani exogamous totem-kulon yaani clans me banti hai. Ek kul ke sadasy ek samanya purvaj yaani common ancestor se utpann maane jaate hain tatha isliye ek hi kul ke do vyaktiyon ke beech yun-sambandh yaani sexual relations ki anumati nahi hoti. Kul ke sadasy ek samanya upnaam yaani surname rakhte hain, jo totem ka naam hota hai. Aaj adhiktar gaon ek se adhik kul ke logon dwara basaye jaate hain. Is tarah kul-vyavastha janjatiya samajik sangathan ki buniyadi ikai hai, jo vivah ke niyamon tatha samajik rishton ko niyantrit karti hai. Exam point: Bihar ki pratyek janjati (Paharia ke atirikt) bahirvivahi totem-kulon me banti hai, jinke sadasy ek samanya purvaj se utpann maane jaate hain, ek hi kul me yun-sambandh varjit hota hai tatha upnaam totem ke naam par hota hai.

qe: In the tribal family of Bihar, how is property divided on the death of the father?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय परिवार में पिता की मृत्यु पर संपत्ति का बँटवारा किस प्रकार होता है?
oe: It is taken over by the village panchayat
It is divided equally between his sons, daughters ordinarily having no right in the father's property
It is divided equally between sons and daughters
It goes entirely to the eldest daughter
oh: इसे गाँव की पंचायत अपने अधिकार में ले लेती है
यह उसके पुत्रों के बीच बराबर बाँट दी जाती है, पुत्रियों का पिता की संपत्ति में सामान्यतः कोई अधिकार नहीं होता
यह पुत्रों तथा पुत्रियों के बीच बराबर बाँट दी जाती है
यह पूरी तरह सबसे बड़ी पुत्री को मिल जाती है
e: Janjatiya samajik sangathan ki pramukh ikai parivar hai, jisme maa-baap tatha unke avivahit bachhe shaamil hote hain. Keval kuchh hi maamlon me do ya adhik vivahit bhai saath rehte hain, jabki kuchh maamlon me buzurg tatha ashakt aashrit janon ka bhi parivar dwara poshan hota hai. Vansh-parampara pita ki or chalti hai, isliye janjatiya vyavastha patrilineal kehlati hai. Aam taur par putriyon ka pita ki sampatti me koi adhikar nahi hota; pita ki maut par unki sampatti uske putron ke beech barabar baant di jaati hai. Nivas-sthan bhi pita ke sthan ke aas-paas hota hai, isliye ise patrilocal kaha jaata hai, tatha rishton ke liye vargikrit yaani classificatory shabdavali ka istemal hota hai, jisme umar tatha nazdeeki ko darshane ke liye antar bhi rakha jaata hai. Exam point: Janjatiya vyavastha patrilineal hai; pita ki maut par sampatti putron ke beech barabar baant di jaati hai tatha putriyon ka pita ki sampatti me aam taur par koi adhikar nahi hota.

qe: In the tribal society of Bihar, what are the 'Kajomesn'?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय समाज में 'काजोमेसन' क्या हैं?
oe: The youth dormitories of the Santhals
The marriage go-betweens of the Mundas
e: Har janjati antarvivahi yaani endogamous hoti hai tatha alag-alag janjatiyon ke stri-purush ke beech sambandh asambhav maana jaata tha. Jo vyakti janjatiya naitikta yaani tribal ethics ka ullanghan karke bahishkrit kar diya jaata tha, usse doosre log sparsh karne se bhi bachte the. Is tarah ashuddhata yaani pollution ki avadharna janjatiya logon me poori tarah karya karti thi. Ho janjati me aise bahishkrit vyaktiyon ko 'Kajomesn' kaha jaata tha. Iske alawa vivaah ke liye janjati ke andar hi jiwan-saathi chunna aavashyak tha tatha vivah ke bina koi vyakti janjati ka poora sadasya nahi ban sakta tha, kyunki janjatiya vishwas me devta tatha aatmaen bhi vivahit maane jaate hain. Exam point: Ho janjati me bahishkrit vyaktiyon ko 'Kajomesn' kaha jaata tha; har janjati antarvivahi thi tatha bahishkar ke karan usse koi sparsh nahi karta tha.

qe: Which of the following statements about the position of women in tribal Bihar is correct?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार में स्त्रियों की स्थिति के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
oe: They had no right to land, but could own movable property such as money, goods and cattle and were in charge of the family purse
They had full rights to land but no rights over movable property
They were confined to the house and were never allowed to visit the market
They had no role in the household or in the rearing of children
oh: उन्हें भूमि पर अधिकार नहीं था, लेकिन धन, माल तथा पशुओं जैसी चल संपत्ति रख सकती थीं और परिवार की गठरी की प्रभारी थीं
उन्हें भूमि पर पूरा अधिकार था, लेकिन चल संपत्ति पर कोई अधिकार नहीं था
वे घर तक सीमित थीं तथा बाजार जाने की कभी अनुमति नहीं थी
घरेलू काम तथा बच्चों के पालन-पोषण में उनकी कोई भूमिका नहीं थी
e: Janjatiya Bihar me striyon ki sthiti anya patrilineal samajon ke mukable itni buri nahi thi. Unhe bhoomi par koi adhikar nahi tha, lekin woh chaar yaani movable sampatti - jaise paisa, maal tatha maveshi - ki maalik ho sakti thin. Woh parivar ki gathari yaani family purse ki prabhari hoti thin tatha ghar chalane ki zimmedar thin. Striyon tatha purushon ke beech parishram ka bantwara aisa tha ki stri ka aarthik yogdan purush ke kaam ka pooorak yaani complementary tha. Woh ghar ki poori prabhari thin tatha bachhon ka paalan-poshan karti thin; khet tatha jungle me bhi unke mahatvapurn kartavya the tatha aam taur par yahi mahila thi jo parivar ki atirikt upaj lekar 'hat' par jaati thi. Isliye unhe purush ke lagbhag barabar mahatvapurn maana jaata tha; kuchh avsaron par woh panchayat me bhi ja sakti thin, lekin kuchh dharmik sanskaron me unki upasthiti nahi hoti thi. Exam point: Janjatiya Bihar ki mahilaon ko bhoomi par adhikar nahi tha, lekin woh paisa, maal tatha maveshi jaise chaar sampatti ki maalik ho sakti thin, parivar ki gathari sambhalti thin tatha upaj lekar hat par jaati thin.

qe: In the tribal society of Bihar, which statement about marriage, widow remarriage and divorce is correct?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय समाज में विवाह, विधवा पुनर्विवाह तथा तलाक के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
oe: Child marriage is the universal rule and divorce is forbidden
Polygamy is compulsory and widow remarriage is prohibited
Marriage is not recognised and no ceremonies are performed
Adult and monogamous marriage is the general rule, and widow remarriage as well as divorce is allowed
oh: बाल-विवाह सार्वभौमिक नियम है तथा तलाक वर्जित है
बहुविवाह अनिवार्य है तथा विधवा पुनर्विवाह निषिद्ध है
विवाह को मान्यता ही नहीं है तथा कोई संस्कार नहीं होता
वयस्क तथा एक-विवाह सामान्य नियम है, तथा विधवा पुनर्विवाह और तलाक दोनों की अनुमति है
e: Janjatiya samaj me vayask yaani adult vitath ek-patni yaani monogamous vivah hi samanya niyam tha, yadyapi Hindu prabhav wale kshetron me vivah ki umar kam ho gayi thi tatha bachpan ka vivah keval dhanvan log apne samman ke liye karte the. Vidhwa punarvivah yaani widow remarriage tatha talaq yaani divorce dono ki anumati thi, lekin talaq ke liye panchayat ki prakriya se guzarna padta tha. Jeewan-saathi chunne me ladka tatha ladki ko aam taur par khol chhoot thi, lekin maa-baap dwara tay kiya gaya vivah sabse achha maana jaata tha. Vivah ke bina koi vyakti janjati ka poora sadasya nahi ban sakta tha, kyunki yahan tak ki devta tatha aatmaen bhi vivahit maane jaate hain. Exam point: Janjatiya samaj me vayask tatha ek-patni vivah samanya niyam tha tatha vidhwa punarvivah aur talaq dono ki anumati thi, lekin talaq ke liye panchayat ki prakriya se guzarna padta tha.

qe: In tribal Bihar, which ceremony marks the end of the period during which the house is considered ritually impure after a childbirth?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार में बच्चे के जन्म के बाद घर के अनुष्ठानिक रूप से अपवित्र माने जाने का दौर किस संस्कार से समाप्त होता है?
e: Janjatiya jeevan me kuchh aise avsar hote hain jo ek charan se doosre charan me sankraman yaani transition ko chinhit karte hain - janm, vivah tatha maut. Garbhavastha ke dauran mahila ko kai taboo manne padte the, jinka ullanghan bachhe me dosh ya kathin prasav ka karan maana jaata tha. Bachhe ke janm par maa-baap ke liye bahut harshosh ka avsar hota hai. Janm ke baad ghar ko ek nirdharit samay tak anushthanik roop se ashuddh yaani ritually impure maana jaata hai, jo janjati-dar-janjati alag hota hai. Is samay ka ant hone par 'Chatti' yaani shuddhikaran ka sanskar kiya jaata hai, jisme bhoj tatha harshosh hota hai; iske baad hi parivar puja karne ke liye paryapt roop se shuddh maana jaata hai. Exam point: Janm ke baad ghar ko kuchh samay tak anushthanik roop se ashuddh maana jaata hai tatha is daur ka ant 'Chatti' yaani shuddhikaran sanskar se hota hai, jiske baad parivar puja ke liye shuddh ho jaata hai.

qe: In the tribal life of Bihar, which ceremony entitles a child to enter formally into the tribe, and at what age is it performed?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय जीवन में कौन-सा संस्कार बच्चे को औपचारिक रूप से जनजाति में प्रवेश का अधिकार देता है तथा यह किस आयु में किया जाता है?
oe: The name-giving ceremony, on the day after birth
The bone-burial ceremony, at about twelve years
The ear-boring ceremony, at about two years of age
The Chatti ceremony, at about six months
oh: नामकरण संस्कार, जन्म के अगले दिन
अस्थि-निक्षेप संस्कार, लगभग बारह वर्ष की आयु में
कान छेदने का संस्कार, लगभग दो वर्ष की आयु में
चट्टी संस्कार, लगभग छह माह की आयु में
e: Janjatiya jeevan me janm ke turant baad kuchh sanskar hote hain. Janm ke doosre din naamkaran yaani name-giving ka sanskar hota hai; bachhe ka naam aam taur par kisi poorvaj ke naam par rakha jaata hai, chahe woh jeevit ho ya mrit, tatha woh us bachhe ka 'Mita' ban jaata hai, ya phir us din ke naam par rakha jaata hai jis din woh paida hua. Kaan chhidwane yaani ear-boring ka sanskar tab kiya jaata hai jab bachha lagbhag do saal ka ho jaata hai; yahi sanskar bachhe ko aupcharik roop se janjati me pravesh ka adhikar deta hai. Yadi koi bachha is sanskar se pehle mar jaaye to uske liye samanya mrityu-sanskar yaani funeral rites nahi kiye jaate. Exam point: Kaan chhidwane yaani ear-boring ka sanskar lagbhag do saal ki umar me hota hai tatha yahi bachhe ko janjati me aupcharik pravesh ka adhikar deta hai; naamkaran janm ke doosre din hota hai tatha naam poorvaj ya dinaam par rakha jaata hai.

qe: In tribal Bihar, what is the effect of the ceremonial friendship or blood brotherhood between two boys or two girls?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार में दो बालकों या दो बालिकाओं के बीच औपचारिक मित्रता या रक्त-भ्रातृत्व का क्या प्रभाव होता है?
oe: No marriage can take place between members of the families of the two ceremonial friends
It makes marriage between the two families compulsory
It has no effect on marriage and is only a game
It transfers the property of one family to the other
oh: दोनों औपचारिक मित्रों के परिवारों के सदस्यों के बीच कोई विवाह नहीं हो सकता
यह दोनों परिवारों के बीच विवाह को अनिवार्य बना देती है
इसका विवाह पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं होता तथा यह केवल एक खेल है
यह एक परिवार की संपत्ति दूसरे को हस्तांतरित कर देती है
e: Janjatiya samaj me ek vishesh rishta, jise sanskarik mitrata yaani ceremonial friendship ya rakt-bhratritva yaani blood brotherhood kaha jaata hai, kabhi-kabhi do ladkon ya do ladkiyon ko jodta hai. Yeh aam taur par saman umar ke bachhon ke beech hota hai tatha iske liye ek vistrit sanskar kiya jaata hai. Is rishte ki shakti tatha pavitrata itni hoti hai ki do sanskarik mitron ke parivaron ke sadasyon ke beech koi vivah nahi ho sakta. Iske alawa janjatiya samaj me bal-vivah keval dhanvan log apne samman ke liye karte the tatha vayask vivah hi samanya niyam tha. Exam point: Do sanskarik mitron yaani ceremonial friends ke parivaron ke sadasyon ke beech vivah varjit hota hai; is rishte ke liye vistrit sanskar kiya jaata hai tatha ise bahut pavitra maana jaata hai.

qe: Among the Mundas of Bihar, what was the traditional bride-price given to the bride's family?
qh: बिहार के मुंडाओं में वधू-पक्ष को दिया जाने वाला परंपरागत वर-मूल्य क्या था?
oe: Fifty rupees and a bronze vessel
One hundred rupees and a plot of land
Twelve rupees and two head of cattle
oh: पचास रुपये तथा एक कांस्य पात्र
एक सौ रुपये तथा भूमि का एक टुकड़ा
e: Janjatiya vivah me vadhu ke parivar ko di gayi raashi yaani bride-price ka kuchh mahatva tha tatha yeh raashi alag-alag janjatiyon me alag hoti thi. Mundas me paramparik vadhu-mulya barah rupaye tatha do maveshi thi, jabki Hos me yeh itna badh gaya tha ki bahut si ladkiyan avivahit hi reh jaati thin. Jeevan-saathi chunne me ladka tatha ladki ko aam taur par chhoot thi, lekin maa-baap dwara tay kiya vivah sabse achha maana jaata tha. 'Raji-khushi' vivah woh tha jisme ladka tatha ladki khud pahal karte the tatha vadhu-mulya par zor nahi diya jaata tha. Vivah ke liye go-between yaani bicholiyon dwara baat tay hoti thi tatha vadhu-mulya dene ki ek tareekh tay ki jaati thi. Exam point: Mundas me paramparik vadhu-mulya barah rupaye tatha do maveshi tha, jabki Hos me yeh itna zyada ho gaya ki kai ladkiyan avivahit reh jaati thin; 'Raji-khushi' vivah me ladka-ladki khud pahal karte the.

qe: In the tribal society of Bihar, what is 'Sagai'?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय समाज में 'सगई' क्या है?
oe: The remarriage of a widow or of a divorced woman
The first proposal of marriage through a go-between
The feast given at the birth of a child
oh: विधवा या तलाकशुदा स्त्री का पुनर्विवाह
बिचौलिये के माध्यम से विवाह का पहला प्रस्ताव
बच्चे के जन्म पर दिया जाने वाला भोज
e: Janjatiya samaj me vidhwa punarvivah yaani widow remarriage tatha talaqshuda stree ke punarvivah ko samanya maana jaata tha tatha ise 'Sagai' kaha jaata tha. Sabse aam prakar ka vivah 'Andi' ya 'Diku-Andi' tha, jo nichle varg ke Hindu vivah ki ek kamzor nakal maana jaata tha. Vivah bicholiyon dwara tay hote the tatha vadhu-mulya dene ke liye ek din nirdharit hota tha, jiske baad ladke ke purush tatha mahila rishtedaar mil kar ladki ke gaon jaate the; vahan vistrit sanskar hote the, khoob khaana-peena hota tha tatha chawal ki dhaaru pee jaati thi. Iske baad ladki ko uske pati ke ghar le jaaya jaata tha, jahan usse saanskarik roop se pati ke kul me shaamil kar liya jaata tha. Exam point: Janjatiya samaj me vidhwa ya talaqshuda stree ke punarvivah ko 'Sagai' kaha jaata tha tatha 'Andi' ya 'Diku-Andi' sabse aam vivah-pratha thi, jo nichle varg ke Hindu vivah ki kamzor nakal maani jaati thi.

qe: Among the Munda, Oraon, Kharia and Ho tribes of Bihar, when is the bone-burial ceremony of the dead held?
qh: बिहार की मुंडा, उराँव, खड़िया तथा हो जनजातियों में मृतकों का अस्थि-निक्षेप संस्कार कब होता है?
oe: Only when a village headman dies
Immediately after every death, on the same day
Every year, when the relics of those who died during the year are interred in the clan Sasan
Once in twelve years, when the whole clan assembles
oh: केवल गाँव के मुखिया की मृत्यु पर
प्रत्येक मृत्यु के तुरंत बाद, उसी दिन
प्रत्येक वर्ष, जब उस वर्ष मरने वालों के अवशेष कुल के सासन में दफन किए जाते हैं
बारह वर्ष में एक बार, जब पूरा कुल एकत्र होता है
e: Janjatiya vishwas me maut ke baad marne wale ki chhaya yaani shade ko saanskarik roop se rasoi ke kone me sthit gupt sthal tak pahunchaya jaata hai, jo poorvajon ki aatmaon ka ghar hota hai. Maut poore parivar ko ashuddh yaani polluted kar deti hai tatha yeh sthiti shuddhikaran ke samaroh ke baad khatm hoti hai. Ek mahatvapurn anushthan me mritak ki chhaya ko wapas bula kar 'Ading' me anya poorvajon ki aatmaon ke saath basaya jaata hai. Munda, Oraon, Kharia tatha Ho janjatiyon me asthi-dafan yaani bone-burial ka samaroh har saal kiya jaata hai, jisme saal bhar me marne wale logon ke avshesh yaani relics unke kul ke 'Sasan' me dafna diye jaate hain. Dhyaan dene wali baat hai ki dhanvan vyakti ke shareer ka dah-sanskar yaani burning kiya jaata tha, jabki garib logon ko dafnaya jaata tha. Exam point: Munda, Oraon, Kharia tatha Ho me asthi-dafan ka samaroh har saal hota hai, jisme us saal marne wale logon ke avshesh kul ke Sasan me dafnaye jaate hain; dhanvan vyakti ka dah-sanskar tatha garib ka dafan hota tha.

qe: In practice, the tribal village panchayat of Bihar consists of the village elders and which officers?
qh: व्यवहार में बिहार का जनजातीय ग्राम पंचायत गाँव के बुजुर्गों तथा किन पदाधिकारियों से मिलकर बनता है?
oe: The patwari, the kanungo and the police chaukidar
The zamindar, the moneylender and the tehsildar
The Raja, the Diwan and the Kotwal
The headman, the priest and the Bhandori or Gorait
oh: मुखिया, पुजारी तथा भंडारी या गोरैत
e: Janjatiya gaon me samajik santulan yaani social equilibrium banaye rakhne ke liye kai sadhan istemal kiye jaate the. Bachpan se hi janjatiya ladka mithak tatha lok-kathayen sunta hai tatha sahi-galat me antar karna seekhta hai. Yadi woh apne samajik vatavaran ke anukul nahi chalta ya janjatiya kanoon todta hai, to uske vyavahar ke virudh kai tarah ke dand yaani sanctions lagte hain; kuchh taboo todne par svatah yaani automatic alaukik dand milta hai. Gaon me janta ki raay yaani public opinion samajik anupalan ke liye ek badi shakti hoti hai; parivarik kartavyon ki upeksha, aashriton ka tyag, mehmanon ko bhoj na dena, karz na chukana, vyabhichar, chori tatha jadu-tone jaise karyon ki kadi ninda hoti hai. Siddhant me panchayat me gaon ke sabhi vayask purush shaamil hote hain, lekin vyavahar me woh gaon ke buzurgon tatha mukhiya, purohit, Bhandori ya Gorait jaise padadhikariyon aur anya prabhavshali purushon se mil kar banti hai. Exam point: Vyavahar me janjatiya gaon ki panchayat gaon ke buzurgon tatha mukhiya, purohit, Bhandori ya Gorait jaise padadhikariyon se mil kar banti hai, jabki siddhant me sabhi vayask purush iske sadasya maane jaate hain.

qe: Which condition among the tribals of Bihar was originally responsible for the Birsa movement and the Tana Bhagat movement?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों में सामाजिक परिवर्तन के विवरण के अनुसार बिरसा आंदोलन तथा टाना भगत आंदोलन मूलतः किस स्थिति का परिणाम थे?
oe: The establishment of the Tribal Research Institute at Ranchi
The frustration caused when the tribal people lost faith in their own values
The prosperity brought by the tea gardens of Assam
The encouragement given by the Christian missionaries
oh: राँची में जनजातीय अनुसंधान संस्थान की स्थापना
उस हताशा का परिणाम, जो जनजातीय लोगों के अपने मूल्यों से विश्वास खो देने पर उत्पन्न हुई
असम के चाय-बागानों से आई समृद्धि
ईसाई मिशनरियों द्वारा दिए गए प्रोत्साहन
e: Adivasi sanskriti bahari prabhavon ke karan tezi se badal rahi thi. Sanchar ke vikas ke saath naye vichar, naye upkaran tatha machinery Adivasi kshetron ke sabse door kono tak pahunch rahe the. Bahar ke jamindar, adalaton se sampark, mahajan tatha sarkari chhote adhikari nayi disha khol rahe the; Christian missionary gaonon me Christ ka sandesh dene ke saath-saath pashchimi sanskriti tatha technology bhi le kar aaye. Assam ke chai-baaghaan, Bengal ki joot mills tatha coal mines aur steel factories se lautne wale janjatiya log tatha shiksha ke prasar ne badlav ki gati tez kar di. In badlavon ke prati janjatiya logon ki pehli mansik pratikriya hatasha yaani frustration thi - unhone apne mulyon par vishwas kho diya tatha woh ya Christian ya Hindu dharma ki or jhukne lage. Birsa movement mool roop se aisi hi paristhitiyon ka parinaam thi; isi tarah Oraon janjati me Tana Bhagat movement bhi aisi paristhitiyon se hi upja. Exam point: Janjatiya logon ki pehli mansik pratikriya hatasha thi tatha Birsa movement aur Tana Bhagat movement mool roop se inhi paristhitiyon ka parinaam the.

qe: How was an oath taken before a tribal panchayat in Bihar, and what was believed to happen to a person who made a false statement?
qh: बिहार में जनजातीय पंचायत के समक्ष शपथ किस प्रकार ली जाती थी तथा झूठा बयान देने वाले के साथ क्या होता माना जाता था?
oe: The deponent had to touch the village priest's feet; a liar was believed to lose his speech
A little paddy, cow-dung and a clod of earth were placed on the head; a false deponent was believed to lose crops, cattle and land
The deponent had to swear by holding a sword in his hand; a liar was believed to lose his eyesight
The deponent had to drink water from the village well; a liar was believed to fall ill at once
oh: शपथ लेने वाले को गाँव के पुजारी के चरण छूने पड़ते थे; झूठे की वाणी चली जाने की मान्यता थी
सिर पर थोड़ा धान, गोबर तथा मिट्टी का ढेला रखा जाता था; झूठ बोलने वाले की फसल, पशु तथा भूमि नष्ट हो जाने की मान्यता थी
शपथ लेने वाले को हाथ में तलवार रखकर कसम खानी पड़ती थी; झूठे की दृष्टि चली जाने की मान्यता थी
शपथ लेने वाले को गाँव के कुएँ का पानी पीना पड़ता था; झूठे को तुरंत बीमार पड़ने की मान्यता थी
e: Janjatiya panchayat ke samne vadi tatha prativadi dono aakar apne bayan dete the tatha shapath lete the. Shapath lene wala vyakti thoda sa dhan yaani paddy, thoda gobar tatha mitti ka ek dhela lekar unhe apne sir par rakhta tha. Manyata thi ki jo vyakti jhoota bayan dega, uski fasal, maveshi tatha zameen nashth ho jaayegi, isliye log shapath ko bahut gambhirta se lete the. Pehle ke samay me pareeksha dwara nyay yaani trial by ordeal ka bhi sahara liya jaata tha. Gawahon ko bulakar dono pakshon ke bayanon ki pushti karai jaati thi tatha panchayat ka mukhiya faisla sunata tha; yeh faisla panchayat ki soch-vichar se nikla nirnay hota tha, jiski bahut badi shakti hoti thi tatha koi usse avagya karne ki himmat nahi karta tha. Exam point: Janjatiya panchayat ke samne shapath lene wala vyakti thoda dhan, gobar tatha mitti ka dhela sir par rakhta tha tatha manyata thi ki jhoota shapath lene wale ki fasal, maveshi tatha zameen nashth ho jaati hai.

qe: Which of the following marked the second psychological phase in the social change of the tribal people of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों के सामाजिक परिवर्तन में दूसरा मनोवैज्ञानिक चरण किससे चिह्नित हुआ?
oe: The sale of all their land to the moneylenders
The closure of the Dhumkuria and the Parha organisations
The rediscovery of their own culture and a reawakening of pride in it
The complete abandonment of their traditional dances
oh: अपनी सारी भूमि महाजनों को बेच देना
धुमकुरिया तथा परहा संस्थाओं का बंद हो जाना
अपनी संस्कृति की पुनर्खोज तथा उसके प्रति गर्व का पुनर्जागरण
अपने परंपरागत नृत्यों का पूर्ण परित्याग
e: Shiksha tatha sanskritik sampark ke badhne se janjatiya samaj me doosra mansik charan shuru hua, jise unki apni sanskriti ki punah-khoj yaani rediscovery kaha ja sakta hai. Is charan me janjatiya sanskriti ke kuchh pahluon ke prati garv ka punarjagran hua - janjatiya nritya tatha sansthaon ka punarmulyankan hua, nrityon ki samikshakon ne khoob prashansa ki tatha unhe All-India pratiyogitaon me puraskar mile; Oraon nritya ne vishesh pehchan banayi. Dhumkuria ko janjatiya netaon dwara aupcharik shiksha ke sthal ke roop me lokpriya banaya ja raha hai tatha Parha sanstha ka bhi punarjeevan ho raha hai. Samaj ke unn sabhi gyani tatvon ne azadi ki ladai me bhaag liya tha tatha azadi milne ke baad woh apne adhikaron ke prati sajag hokar prashasan me sakriya bhaagidari tatha shoshan ke ant ki maang karne lage. Exam point: Doosra mansik charan apni sanskriti ki punah-khoj se chinhit hua, jisme janjatiya nritya ko puraskar mile, Oraon nritya charchit hua tatha Dhumkuria aur Parha sansthaon ka punarjeevan shuru hua.

qe: What punishment did the tribal panchayats of Bihar usually impose, and what happened to a man who refused to pay the fine imposed by the panchayat?
qh: बिहार की जनजातीय पंचायतें सामान्यतः क्या दंड देती थीं तथा पंचायत के लगाए जुर्माने को देने से इनकार करने वाले व्यक्ति के साथ क्या होता था?
oe: Forfeiture of all his land; the man refusing to pay was expelled from the district
Corporal punishment only; the man refusing to pay was made a slave for life
Fines and excommunication; the man refusing to pay was boycotted by the whole village
Imprisonment in the village lock-up; the man refusing to pay was handed over to the police
oh: उसकी सारी भूमि जब्त; जुर्माना न देने वाले को जिले से निकाल दिया जाता था
केवल शारीरिक दंड; जुर्माना न देने वाले को जीवन भर का दास बना दिया जाता था
जुर्माना तथा बहिष्कार; जुर्माना न देने वाले व्यक्ति का पूरा गाँव बहिष्कार कर देता था
गाँव के हवालात में कैद; जुर्माना न देने वाले को पुलिस को सौंप दिया जाता था
e: Janjatiya panchayaton ka karya-kshetra seemit tatha spashth tha. Unke samne aise maamle aate the jinke liye kanoon me saza ka saaf pravdhan tha - jaise khoon-rishti ke saath sambandh, talaq, vyabhichar, maar-peet, chot pahunchana, jaan-boojh kar sampatti ko nashth karna, parivarik sampatti ka batwara, uttaradhikar ke vivaad tatha jadu-tone ka sandeh. Panchayat aam taur par do tarah ki sazaen deti thi - jurmana tatha bahishkar yaani excommunication. Chhoti chori ke liye aparadhi ko jurmana tatha pitai di jaati thi. Jo vyakti panchayat ka lagaya jurmana dene se inkar karta tha, usse poora gaon bahishkar yaani boycott kar deta tha; asthayi bahishkar ki saza bhi di ja sakti thi. Is tarah panchayat ke nirnay ka bahut prabhav tha tatha samajik dabaav unhe lagu karane ka pramukh sadhan tha. Exam point: Janjatiya panchayaten aam taur par jurmana tatha bahishkar ki saza deti thin; chhoti chori par jurmana tatha pitai hoti thi tatha jurmana dene se inkar karne wale vyakti ka poora gaon bahishkar kar deta tha.

qe: Which of the following material changes came into the lives of the Adivasis of Bihar in modern times?
qh: आधुनिक समय में बिहार के आदिवासियों के जीवन में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से भौतिक परिवर्तन आए?
oe: Beds, country-made chairs, umbrellas replacing indigenous lamps with lanterns, and shoes, shirts and shorts becoming common
Complete absence of any manufactured goods in tribal homes
A return to the leaf booth and wicker walls
The replacement of soap and cosmetics by herbal medicines
oh: पलंग, देसी कुर्सियाँ, छाते; देसी दीयों के स्थान पर लालटेन; तथा जूते, कमीज और निकर का प्रचलन बढ़ना
जनजातीय घरों में निर्मित वस्तुओं का पूर्ण अभाव
पत्तों की कुटिया तथा बेंत की दीवारों की ओर वापसी
साबुन तथा सौंदर्य-प्रसाधनों का जड़ी-बूटियों से प्रतिस्थापन
e: Adivasi jeevan ke saamagri yaani material paksha me bade badlav aaye the. Pehle patton se bani kutiya tatha bet ki deewar wale gharon ka sthan ab kaafi mazboot gharon ne le liya tha; adhiktar gharon me ab palang, desi kursiyan, ek-do cups tatha saucers tatha aadhunik chhate nazar aate the. Tel ke desi diyon ki jagah lantern yaani lalten ne le li thi. Mahilaen chamakdar gehne tatha mill ke bane jumper pasand karne lagin. Jin audyogik kshetron me kaam badha, wahan soap, hair oil, cosmetics tatha kumkum ameer-garib sabhi ke gharon tak pahunch gaye. Joote aam ho gaye tatha paramparik veshbhusha ki jagah shirt tatha shorts lokpriya hone lage. Is tarah bahari prabhavon ne janjatiya jeevan ke pratyek paksha ko chhua, chahe woh kapde ho, gehne ya gharelu saamaan. Exam point: Adivasi gharon me palang, desi kursiyan, chhate tatha lalten aayin, mahilaon me mill ke jumper tatha cosmetics ka prachar badha tatha shirt-shorts tatha joote aam hone lage.

qe: Among the Santhals of Bihar, what was 'Bitlaha', the most extreme form of social punishment?
qh: बिहार के संथालों में सामाजिक दंड का सबसे कठोर रूप 'बितलाहा' क्या था?
oe: A punishment pronounced for family or clan incest or sexual relations with non-Santhals, in which the offender's house was desecrated and the offender socially excommunicated
A fine of a fixed number of cattle imposed for petty theft
A ritual purification ceremony performed after a quarrel in the family
A dance performed to welcome a newly married couple into the village
oh: परिवार या कुल-विवाह अथवा गैर-संथालों से यौन-संबंध जैसे गंभीर अपराधों पर दिया जाने वाला दंड, जिसमें अपराधी का घर अपवित्र किया जाता था तथा उसका सामाजिक बहिष्कार कर दिया जाता था
छोटी चोरी पर लगाया जाने वाला निश्चित संख्या में पशुओं का जुर्माना
परिवार में झगड़े के बाद किया जाने वाला शुद्धिकरण संस्कार
नवविवाहित युगल के गाँव में स्वागत हेतु किया जाने वाला नृत्य
e: Santhal janjati me samajik dand ka sabse kathor roop 'Bitlaha' kaha jaata tha. Yeh ghar ke andar ya kul me rashtra-bhrasht tatha pati-patni ke rishte, athva aise sambandh jaise parivar ya kul me vyabhichar ya gair-Santhal ke saath yun-sambandh jaise gambhir aparadhon ke liye lagaya jaata tha. Jab gaon ki panchayat Bitlaha ka nirnay leti thi, to aas-paas ke ilakon me khabar bheji jaati thi tatha nirdharit din par log sainkdon tatha hazaaron ki sankhya me ikattha ho jaate the. Bheed aparadhi ke ghar tak jaati thi aur raaste me apmaanjanak yaani obscene geet gaakar uski khili-udai karti thi; baad me bheed uske ghar ko apavitra yaani desecrate kar deti thi tatha kabhi-kabhi hinsa bhi ki jaati thi. Bitlaha panchayat dwara laid roop se bahishkar ki saza ke baad hota tha tatha yeh poore samuday ki kathor asvikriti ki samajik abhivyakti thi. Exam point: Santhalon me 'Bitlaha' sabse kathor samajik dand tha, jo parivar ya kul me vyabhichar tatha gair-Santhal ke saath sambandh jaise aparadhon par lagta tha; isme bheed apmaanjanak geet gaakar aparadhi ke ghar ko apavitra karti thi.

qe: What were the 'gram golas' opened in the tribal areas of Bihar, and on what terms was grain given from them?
qh: बिहार के जनजातीय क्षेत्रों में खोले गए 'ग्राम गोला' क्या थे तथा उनसे अनाज किन शर्तों पर दिया जाता था?
oe: Government warehouses for exporting grain to Assam
Free kitchens where cooked food was served daily
Shops selling agricultural implements on cash payment only
Grain stores where grain was given on loan to agriculturists to be returned at the next harvest with interest lower than that charged by others
oh: असम को अनाज निर्यात करने के लिए सरकारी गोदाम
प्रतिदिन पका भोजन बाँटने वाली मुफ्त रसोइयाँ
केवल नकद भुगतान पर कृषि-औजार बेचने वाली दुकानें
अनाज के भंडार, जहाँ कृषकों को अगली फसल पर लौटाने के लिए ऋण के रूप में अनाज दिया जाता था, ब्याज अन्य देने वालों से कम रखा जाता था
e: Janjatiya logon ki samasyayen kai thin tatha rajya sarkar unhe apne adhikariyon ke zariye pratyaksh roop se, ya gair-sarkari kalyankari sansthaon ko udar anudan dekar apratyaksh roop se, hal karne ka prayas kar rahi thi. Jyada se jyada school tatha hostel kholay ja rahe the tatha sanchar-sadhan sudhare ja rahe the. Dawakhane tatha chikitsa-sahayata bhi pradan ki ja rahi thi tatha chhoti tatha madhyam sinchai yojnaon ki shuruat hui thi. Badhi hui rin-suvidha dete hue sainkdon 'gram gola' kholay gaye the, jahan kisanon ko anaj rin ke roop me diya jaata tha, jise unhe agli fasal par lautaana hota tha; is par lagne wala byaaj anya rin dene waale mahajanon dwara lagaye jaane waale byaaj se kam tha. Pahadi ilakon me rehne wali janjatiyon ko udar anudan, zameen, bail tatha anya krishi-yantron ke zariye niche aane ke liye prerit kiya ja raha tha tatha unhe shifting cultivation se dur karne ke liye vanya-ropan yaani afforestation ki ja rahi thi; Paharia tatha Kharia punarvas yojnayen bhi chal rahi thin. Exam point: 'Gram gola' anaj ke bhandaar the, jahan kisanon ko anaj is shart par rin diya jaata tha ki woh agli fasal par use lauta denge; byaaj anya mahajanon se kam rakha jaata tha.

qe: Which of the following offences came within the purview of the tribal panchayats of Bihar?
qh: निम्नलिखित अपराधों में कौन-कौन बिहार की जनजातीय पंचायतों के कार्यक्षेत्र में आते थे?
oe: Only disputes relating to land revenue
Only cases between tribals and the Government
Breach of clan exogamy, sexual relations with a person of another tribe, divorce, adultery, assault and disputes about succession
oh: केवल जनजातीय लोगों तथा सरकार के बीच के मामले
कुल-बहिर्विवाह के नियम का उल्लंघन, दूसरी जनजाति के व्यक्ति से यौन-संबंध, तलाक, व्यभिचार, आक्रमण तथा उत्तराधिकार के विवाद
