e: Janjatiya panchayaton ke samne sabse mahatvapurn samajik aparadh woh the jo kul-vyavastha tatha janjatiya seemaon se jude the - jaise kul-bahirvivah yaani clan exogamy ke kanoon ka ullanghan tatha kisi anya janjati ke vyakti ke saath yun-sambandh. Inke alawa talaq, vyabhichar, maar-peet, chot pahunchana, jaan-boojh kar sampatti ko nashth karna, parivarik sampatti ka batwara, uttaradhikar ke vivaad tatha jadu-tone yaani witchcraft ka sandeh bhi panchayat ke samne laye jaate the. Gaon ki panchayat ke faisle ke virudh appeal ke liye kai gaonon ko milakar banayi gayi bade sthar ki sanstha 'Parha' ki panchayat thi, jahan bahishkar se jude maamle aam taur par bheje jaate the. Is tarah janjatiya nyay-vyavastha sthaniya tatha pradeshik, dono sthar par karya karti thi. Exam point: Janjatiya panchayaton ke samne mukhya roop se kul-bahirvivah ke ullanghan, anya janjati se yun-sambandh, talaq, vyabhichar, maar-peet, sampatti-vivaad tatha jadu-tone ke sandeh jaise maamle aate the.

qe: Where is the Tribal Research Institute that studies the special problems of the tribes of Bihar located?
qh: बिहार की जनजातियों की विशेष समस्याओं का अध्ययन करने वाला जनजातीय अनुसंधान संस्थान कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Janjatiya sanskriti, unki paristhitiyon tatha samasyan ke adhyayan se pata chalta hai ki unme alag-alag visheshtayen hone ke bawajood ek hi kshetra me rehne wale janjatiya tatha gair-janjatiya logon ke aarthik tatha anya sambandhi paksha ek jaise hote hain. Isliye janjatiya sanskriti ko Bihar ke jeevan aur gatividhiyon se bilkul alag yaani foreign nahi maana ja sakta; uski alag visheshtayen tatha rangin roop Bihar ke samajik jeevan ke rangbirange chitra yaani mosaic pattern me apna yogdan deti hain. Rajya me Ranchi me sthit Janjatiya Anusandhan Sansthan yaani Tribal Research Institute ab janjatiyon ki vishesh samasyayon ka adhyayan sarkar ki kalyan-kari gatividhiyon ke sandarbh me kar raha hai. Yeh sanstha janjatiya samajik tatha aarthik samasyayon ke samadhan ke liye nitiyan tay karne me madad karti hai. Exam point: Bihar me janjatiyon ki samasyayon ka adhyayan karne wala Janjatiya Anusandhan Sansthan (Tribal Research Institute) Ranchi me sthit hai.

qe: In tribal Bihar, what was the 'Parha'?
qh: जनजातीय बिहार में 'परहा' क्या था?
oe: A religious festival celebrated only by the Mundas
A group of villages united under a higher panchayat, which was a court of appeal from the judgments of the village panchayat
A single village council consisting only of the headman
A market for the sale of cattle held after the harvest
oh: केवल मुंडाओं द्वारा मनाया जाने वाला धार्मिक त्योहार
कई गाँवों का एक ऊँची पंचायत के अधीन संघ, जो ग्राम पंचायत के निर्णयों के विरुद्ध अपील न्यायालय था
केवल मुखिया से मिलकर बनी एकल ग्राम परिषद
फसल कटाई के बाद लगने वाला पशु-बाजार
e: Janjatiya Bihar me pehle gaonon ke samuh ek 'Parha' ke antargat ek jut hote the. Yeh sanstha Oraon tatha Munda janjatiyon me sabse vistrit tatha sabse vikasit roop me thi. Parha Panch ki sanrachna Chotanagpur ke Rajaon ke darbar ke adarsh par bani thi tatha Pratyek Parha Panch me Raja, Diwan, Kotwal, Pandey, Lal Sipahi aadi kai pad hote the; yeh sabhi pad vanshanugat yaani hereditary the tatha gaon ke mukhiyon dwara vivah ya nit-vivah ke liye chune gaye. Parha Panchayat gaon ki panchayat ke faislon ke virudh apil yaani appeal ka nyayalaya thi tatha bahishkar yaani excommunication se jude maamle aam taur par isi ko bheje jaate the. Parha ki baithak us gaon me hoti thi jahan vivad utha ho tatha nirdharit tareekh par alag-alag gaon ke pratinidhi wahan ikattha hote the. Iski prakriya gaon ki panchayat se adhik vistrit thi tatha iske nirnay ka sarvatra samman hota tha. Exam point: Parha gaonon ka ek sangh tha, jiski panchayat gaon ki panchayat ke nirnayon ke virudh appeal nyayalaya ka kaam karti thi tatha jiske pad (Raja, Diwan, Kotwal, Pandey, Lal Sipahi) vanshanugat hote the.

qe: Which resettlement schemes were in progress for the tribal people of Bihar in the modern period?
qh: आधुनिक काल में बिहार के जनजातीय लोगों के लिए कौन-सी पुनर्वास योजनाएँ चल रही थीं?
oe: The Oraon and Ho canal colony schemes
The Birhor and Dusadh plantation schemes
The Paharia and Kharia resettlement schemes
The Munda and Santhal city housing schemes
oh: उराँव तथा हो नहर उपनिवेश योजनाएँ
मुंडा तथा संथाल शहरी आवास योजनाएँ
e: Janjatiya kshetron me sarkar dwara kai kalyan-kari kadam utaye ja rahe the. Pahadi ilakon me rehne wali janjatiyon ko udar anudan, zameen, bail tatha anya krishi-yantron ke zariye niche aane ke liye prerit kiya ja raha tha tatha unhe kheti ke purane dhang yaani shifting cultivation se hataane ke liye van-vistar yaani afforestation karaya ja raha tha. Isi kram me 'Paharia' tatha 'Kharia' punarvas yaani resettlement yojnayen chal rahi thin. Community Projects tatha N.E.S. Blocks kholne se janjatiya logon ke liye ek nayi disha khuli thi tatha unhe aay ka sahayak sadhan dene ke liye shilp tatha cottage industries shuru ki gayi thin. In yojnaon ka uddeshya janjatiya logon ki aarthik sthiti sudharna tatha unhe mukhya dhara se jodna tha. Exam point: Janjatiya Biharon me Paharia tatha Kharia punarvas yojnayen chal rahi thin tatha pahadi janjatiyon ko anudan, zameen, bail aur krishi-yantron ke saath niche laakar shifting cultivation se hataane ke liye afforestation ki ja rahi thi.

qe: In the tribal Bihar of the past, which person took food first at the hands of a tribesman who had been readmitted to the caste by the Parha Panch?
qh: पूर्वकाल के जनजातीय बिहार में परहा पंच द्वारा जाति में पुनः स्वीकृत व्यक्ति के हाथ से सबसे पहले भोजन कौन करता था?
e: Parha Panch ka ek anya mahatvapurn karya pehle bahishkrit yaani outcasted kar diye gaye vyaktiyon ko punah jati me shaamil karna tha, yadi woh apni galti sudharne tatha aavashyak jurmana dene ke liye taiyarikk ho. Aise punah-sweekrit vyakti ke haath se sabse pehle bhojan lene wale vyakti ko 'Kartaha' kaha jaata tha. Lekin purani sthiti ki poori wapasi nahi hoti thi; kalank yaani stigma bana rehta tha tatha punah-sweekrit vyaktiyon ka darja pehle jaisa nahi ho jaata tha. Ho janjati me aise punah-sweekrit bahishkrit vyakti ek alag antarvivahi samajik samuh banate the, jise Kajomesin kaha jaata tha. Iske alawa Parha Panch ke sadasyon ko un gaon ke logon dwara bhoj bhi karaya jaata tha jahan baithak hoti thi tatha aparadhi se vasoole gayi nakad ya jinsi jurmane ki raashi se bhi unhe kuchh milta tha. Exam point: Parha Panch dwara punah jati me liye gaye vyakti ke haath se sabse pehle bhojan lene wale ko 'Kartaha' kaha jaata tha; Ho janjati me aise punah-sweekrit log Kajomesin naamak alag antarvivahi samuh banate the.

qe: Among the Hos of Bihar, the readmitted outcastes formed which kind of social group?
qh: बिहार के हो जनजाति में पुनः स्वीकृत बहिष्कृत व्यक्ति किस प्रकार का सामाजिक समूह बनाते थे?
oe: A separate endogamous group known as Kajomesin
A separate tribe with its own headman
A group of traders dealing with the Dikus
oh: काजोमेसिन नामक एक अलग अंतर्विवाही समूह
अपने स्वयं के मुखिया वाली एक अलग जनजाति
दिकुओं से व्यापार करने वाले व्यापारियों का समूह
e: Janjatiya panchayaton ki sazaon me bahishkar yaani excommunication sabse kathor saza maani jaati thi. Bahishkrit vyakti ke saath khana-peena, vivah tatha anya samajik sambandh band kar diye jaate the tatha usse koi sparsh bhi nahi karta tha. Lekin Parha Panch ke zariye aise vyaktiyon ko punah jati me liya ja sakta tha, yadi woh apna vyavahar sudharne tatha aavashyak jurmana dene ke liye taiyar ho. Ho janjati me aise punah-sweekrit bahishkrit vyakti ek alag antarvivahi yaani endogamous samajik samuh banate the, jise 'Kajomesin' kaha jaata tha. Is tarah bahishkar ke karan paida hui samajik doori poori tarah khatm nahi hoti thi tatha ek alag samuhik pehchan ban jaati thi, jo aage chalkar aapas me hi vivah karne lagti thi. Exam point: Ho janjati me punah-sweekrit bahishkrit vyakti 'Kajomesin' naamak alag antarvivahi samuh banate the, kyunki bahishkar ke baad poori samajik sveekriti dobara nahi milti thi.

qe: What was the status of the Parha system in tribal Bihar in later times?
qh: परवर्ती समय में जनजातीय बिहार में परहा व्यवस्था की क्या स्थिति थी?
oe: It had completely replaced the village panchayats
It was abolished by the Government and its officers were imprisoned
It had become the highest court of appeal for the whole province
It was no longer very active except in a few areas, mainly under the inspiration of converted tribesmen
oh: इसने ग्राम पंचायतों का स्थान पूरी तरह ले लिया था
सरकार ने इसे समाप्त कर दिया था तथा इसके पदाधिकारियों को जेल में डाल दिया था
यह पूरे प्रांत के लिए सर्वोच्च अपील न्यायालय बन गई थी
यह कुछ ही क्षेत्रों में सक्रिय रह गई थी, मुख्यतः धर्मांतरित जनजातीय लोगों की प्रेरणा से
e: Parha vyavastha janjatiya Bihar me pehle bahut mahatvapurn thi, lekin samay ke saath iska prabhav kam hota gaya. Parha vyavastha ab keval kuchh hi kshetron me sakriya bachi hai, mukhya roop se dharmantarit yaani converted janjatiya logon ki nayi prerana ke karan. Aise kshetron se bhi bahut kam maamle sarkar dwara sanchlit gaon-kachhdi yaani gram-kachahari ya adalaton tak jaate hain, kyunki gaon tatha Parha sthar par hi zyadatar vivad nipat jaate hain. Iske bawajood Parha sanstha janjatiya samajik tatha nyayik vyavastha ka ek mahatvapurn hissa rahi hai tatha aaj bhi ise kai jagah samman ki drishti se dekha jaata hai. Exam point: Parha vyavastha ab keval kuchh kshetron me hi sakriya hai, mukhya roop se dharmantarit janjatiya logon ki prerana se; in kshetron se bhi bahut kam maamle sarkari gram-kachahari ya adalaton tak pahunchte hain.
